skilllist.skilldesc:
Hirara wields <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font> (Skill 1) and <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> (Skill 2). Drag one skill onto the other to cast a Combo Skill. Hirara has 4 stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font> Energy. Casting Skill 1 or 2 consumes 1 <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font> Energy, while casting a Combo Skill consumes 2. Her Energy fully recovers after 4s (casting skills interrupts the recovery).

Skills cast with <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> apply <font color="a6aafb">Crimson</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Death</font> marks to non-minion enemies, respectively. Enemies marked with both are immobilized for 0.8s (Cooldown: 3s).

Hirara does not benefit from Cooldown Reduction. Instead, it reduces the energy recovery time of <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font>.

Hirara uses <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font> to sweep a fan-shaped area, dealing 275<font color="fba51f"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

Skills cast with <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font> will deal damage again at the target location after a delay, dealing 2 time(s) the original damage.

Hirara uses the power of <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> to dance in the Sanzu, dashing in the target direction and dealing 275<font color="fba51f"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit. She can dash again after the first dash. At the end of the dash, she unleashes a water wave forward, dealing 275<font color="fba51f"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

Skills cast with <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> have two dashes.

Hirara releases the seal on <font color="a6aafb">Twin Fans: Ukifune</font>, gaining a burst of Movement Speed that decays over 1s. Her max <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font> Energy increases to 6 for 10s. Each kill or assist during this period extends the duration by 4s.

Her Energy fully recovers after 4s (casting skills interrupts the recovery).

Hirara does not benefit from Cooldown Reduction. Instead, it reduces the energy recovery time of <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font>.

Hirara merges <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font> into <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> to cast a Combo Skill. She dashes in the target direction and spins, dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+35% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. This skill applies the effect of <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font>, dealing 2 time(s) of the original damage after a delay.

Hirara merges <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> into <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font> to cast a Combo Skill. She becomes untargetable and immobilized for up to 1s (can be interrupted by moving after 0.6s). She deals 60<font color="fba51f"> (+35% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> upon ending, and can then cast the two dashes of <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font>.

Hirara releases the seal on <font color="a6aafb">Twin Fans: Ukifune</font>, gaining a burst of Movement Speed that decays over 1s. Her max <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font> Energy increases to 6 for 10s. Each kill or assist during this period extends the duration by 4s.

assist.desc: Hirara has high damage output in the early-to-mid game, but the delay in her skills makes landing them less consistent. Hirara works especially well with strong early-game heroes with CC, such as Angela and Minotaur, allowing her to build an early advantage more easily.

strong.desc: Hirara's high mobility allows her to dive the enemy backline with ease, making her an excellent counter to squishy heroes who lack self-protection, like Ixia and Pharsa.The untargetable effect from Hirara's 2nd + 1st Combo Skill is great against delayed skills that deal high damage, giving her a big advantage when facing heroes like Yin and Gusion.

weak.desc: However, while Hirara is quick and nimble, she is also quite fragile. Against burst Assassins with targeted abilities, such as Saber and Natalia, it can be difficult to predict their attacks and use her 2nd + 1st Combo Skill in time. If she gets caught, she'll be taken down instantly.

skilllist.skilldesc:
After dealing damage, Aulus adds a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Fighting Spirit</font> to his axe per second for 4s (up to 6 stacks). Each stack grants 7.5 (+0.5*Hero Level)% Attack Speed. At max <font color="a6aafb">Fighting Spirit</font> stacks, Aulus's Basic Attack is enhanced and gains Attack Range.

Enhanced Basic Attack: Aulus slams his axe into the ground, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> (+ 4 (+0.4*Hero Level)% target's Max HP) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a line.

Aulus starts accumulating <font color="a6aafb">Fighting Spirit</font>, removes all slow effects, and gains 30% extra Movement Speed for 5s.

If Aulus does not take high-level control effects within 2s, he will enter the <font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font> state and gain Control Immunity.

Aulus swings his axe, dealing 240<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

Upon hitting an enemy, Aulus can cast this skill again to dash forward and smash the ground, dealing 240<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

Aulus repeatedly swings his axe at nearby enemies, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each time. After 4 strikes, Aulus briefly charges before unleashing a wider slash, dealing 450<font color="fba51f"> (+180% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a large area.

During this skill, Aulus gains 20% Damage Reduction and a short burst of Movement Speed with each slash.

Marcel's split soul, <font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font>, enters the camera to freeze the moment. Marcel's Basic Attacks deal 50<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe">(+40% Total Magic Defense)</font><font color="fba51f"><1065 0.4></font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (cannot Crit). He cannot benefit from extra Attack Speed. Extra HP is converted into 1.5% Hybrid Defense.

<font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> automatically snaps photos of enemy heroes near Marcel, causing a brief <font color="a6aafb">Frozen Moment</font> and dealing 20 (+ 5% their Max HP) <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> (triggers Attack Effects). It also grants a shield of the same value to Marcel and a nearby allied hero. Cooldown: 12s per target (each Basic Attack from Marcel reduces this cooldown by 1s).

<font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> focuses on an area around Marcel, slowing enemy heroes within by 20%. After 2.5s, he completes the shot, dealing 370<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe">(+100% Total Magic Defense)</font><font color="fba51f"><1065 1></font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1s.

Artist inspiration time! Marcel enters the <font color="a6aafb">Tracking Haste</font> state for 3s, gaining 15% Movement Speed (increases to 75% when moving toward enemy heroes).

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Marcel dashes in the target direction, leaving a framing phantom behind. If <font color="a6aafb">Framed Moment</font> is active, <font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> remains at the original location to continue shooting.

Marcel and <font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> perform a joint shoot. After a short delay, <font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> takes a wide-angle shot of the target area for 3s. During this time, Marcel enters the <font color="a6aafb">Tracking Haste</font> state while inside the area. All other units in the area are put into a <font color="a6aafb">Frozen Moment</font> and are immune to all effects except from Marcel. All ranged Basic Attacks and projectiles are also frozen and will continue after a delay.

<font color="a6aafb">Golden Hour</font> resets the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Platinum Snap</font> for each enemy hero.
Allied heroes with the <font color="a6aafb">Platinum Snap</font> shield can move freely within the area.

data.name: Marcel
data.story: Hailing from House Paxley, he is an elegant, mysterious, and bizarre artist whose split soul has fused with his camera.

assist.desc: Because of Marcel's excellent AOE CC, he pairs well with allies with high AOE damage, like Hanabi and Ixia, to maximize their damage potential.

strong.desc: Marcel is more effective against low-mobility heroes, such as Layla and Vexana, as they are easily caught by his Ultimate, allowing him and his allies to secure easy kills.

weak.desc: Heroes who possess Invincibility or Untargetable effects that can bypass Marcel's CC, like Ling and X.Borg, will reduce his impact on the battlefield.

Eudora casts Forked Lightning in a fan-shaped area, dealing 275<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (increased to 200% against minions) to enemies within.

When hitting targets affected by <font color="a6aafb">Superconductor</font>, Eudora forms a lightning chain with the target, gaining 40% Movement Speed during the chain for up to 1s.
The lightning chain deals 10<font color="62f8fe"> (+4% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> over time and an additional 275<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> when it ends. If this hit lands, it reduces this skill's cooldown by 1.5s.

Eudora hurls an orb of lightning at the target enemy, reducing their Magic Defense by 10 for 1.8s, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, and stunning them for 1s.

If the target is affected by <font color="a6aafb">Superconductor</font>, the lightning orb reduces the Magic Defense of nearby enemies, deals AOE damage centered on the target, and stuns all nearby enemies.

Eudora calls down a blast of lightning on the target area, dealing 600<font color="62f8fe"> (+160% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to targets at the center. Then it strikes targets outside the center, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

Every time Thunder's Wrath hits a target affected by <font color="a6aafb">Superconductor</font>, it triggers a <font color="a6aafb">Thunderburst</font> centered on the <font color="a6aafb">Superconductor</font> target after a short delay, dealing 330<font color="62f8fe"> (+110% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

data.name: Sora
data.story: A pure and free-spirited boy with unshakeable resolve, drifting across the golden sands.

assist.desc: Sora's transformed Ultimate deals considerable damage, and pairing him with Tigreal, Minotaur, Gatotkaca, and other strong CC heroes will maximize Sora's damage potential.

Obsidia gains <font color="a6aafb">Bone Energy</font> whenever she deals damage. Basic Attacks grant 1 Energy against non-hero units and 2 against hero units. Skills grant Energy equal to 3 times the amount granted by Basic Attacks against the same unit type. No Energy is gained from hitting creeps.

At 30 <font color="a6aafb">Bone Energy</font>, it forms a <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shard</font> (up to 25 shards). Killing an enemy hero instantly grants 1 <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shard(s)</font>. When Obsidia uses Basic Attacks, all <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shards</font> strike the target, each dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+6% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (inherits 6% Attack Effects).

Obsidia's Basic Attacks deal 70<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (inherits 100% Attack Effects).

Obsidia launches an <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Bone Needle</font>, dealing 325<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and triggering <font color="a6aafb">Return to Bone</font> on the first enemy hero struck.
Obsidia descends into the Abyss and enters <font color="a6aafb">Shadowmeld Form</font>, gaining 500% Movement Speed for 0.3s.

Obsidia shoots <font color="a6aafb">Bones of Wrath</font> in the target direction, dealing 125<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and briefly stunning the first enemy hero hit, then pulls herself to the target. The <font color="a6aafb">Bones of Wrath</font> tether Obsidia to the enemy, preventing her from moving more than 4 units away. While tethered, the enemy cannot use displacement skills, and their movement will drag Obsidia along. During this time, Obsidia gains 5 temporary <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shards</font> and 30% Attack Speed. This effect lasts 3s.

While tethered, Obsidia can move through obstacles and use Basic Attacks while moving. <font color="a6aafb">Phantom Shadowmeld</font> is enhanced, with its duration increased to 1s and cooldown reduced to 33%.

data.name: Obsidia
data.story: The ancient Sovereign of the Abyss, risen from ruin, now seeks to slay the God of Darkness and hunt down its Spawns of Decay.

assist.desc: Obsidia usually reaches her damage potential in the mid-to-late game, so she wants support heroes who can help her in the early game, like Angela and Estes.

strong.desc: Obsidia's Ultimate will disable dash and blink skills, making her excellent at countering heroes who rely on them,  such as Hayabusa, Freya, and Lancelot.

weak.desc: Obsidia struggles during the early laning phase, making her vulnerable to other Marksmen with strong early game, such as Bruno and Layla.

skilllist.skilldesc:
<font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Crown</font>: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Strike</font> or <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Descent</font>, she gains 1% Spell Vamp for 5s (up to 10 stacks).

<font color="a6aafb">Celestial Robe</font>: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, knocking back and stunning any enemy hero who approaches her, dealing 90(+10*Hero Level)<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. She also gains a 300(+20*Hero Level)<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> shield for 3s. Cooldown: 120s.

Zetian unleashes a <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Wave</font> in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, she automatically casts another wave (up to 3 times). Zetian can cast other skills during this time.

The waves deal 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font>, 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font>, and 360<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, respectively. The 3rd wave has a larger area and pulls enemies toward the cast direction (not considered a control effect).

The Spell Vamp ratio against minions is only 65%.

Zetian summons a <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Spirit</font> at the target location, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and applying a brief 50% slow effect to enemies in the area. The <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Spirit</font> hovers at the location for 3s, dealing 20<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.5s and reducing enemies' Magic Defense by 10% while revealing their surrounding area.
While the <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Spirit</font> is active, Zetian can use this skill again to command it to charge toward a designated location, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and applying a brief 50% slow effect upon arrival.

Zetian calls upon her divine mandate and the hearts of her people, granting all allied heroes 40% Movement Speed that gradually decays over 3s, while bringing divine retribution upon all enemy heroes, dealing 400<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and stunning them for 0.8s. Zetian gains vision of all enemy heroes during this time.
Zetian can cast other skills while channeling this skill.

data.name: Zetian
data.story: Recognized by the Heavens and cherished by her people, the Celestial Empress of the Cadia Riverlands ascends to bring peace to the mortal realm.

assist.desc: While Zetian already has decent survivability, when paired with supports who can protect allies like Floryn and Rafaela, Fighters with limited range will struggle even more to approach Zetian. And with the healing from these supports, Zetian can win any ranged battle of attrition.

strong.desc: Zetian's Passive counters melee heroes with limited gap closers like Balmond and Zilong, allowing her to continue poking the enemy from a safe distance.

weak.desc: Zetian's Ultimate can strike down anywhere on the map, but having such a powerful Ult means a hero like Valentina can also use it against Zetian's team.

skilllist.skilldesc:
After casting a skill, Kalea creates a <font color="a6aafb">Water Zone</font> on the ground. When Kalea casts a skill within this zone, she will absorb the Water Zone to enhance her next three Basic Attacks with different effects:
First Basic Attack: Kalea dashes to the target, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.
Second Basic Attack: Kalea unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and recovering 40<font color="26e407"> (+10% Total HP)</font>  <font color="62f8fe">(+60% Total Magic Power)</font> HP for herself and the nearby ally with the lowest HP.
Third Basic Attack: Kalea uses her tail to strike the area around her target, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and creating a new <font color="a6aafb">Water Zone</font>. Enhanced Basic Attacks are not affected by Attack Speed.

Kalea slams her fist into the ground, creating a wave that deals 200<font color="26e407"> (+5% Total HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 1.5s.

Kalea charges forward and body slams the first enemy hero she encounters, knocking them airborne for 0.6s (unaffected by Resilience) while dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.
If she collides with an obstacle or touches the edge of a <font color="a6aafb">Water Zone</font> during her charge, Kalea will leap into the air. Cast the skill again to slam down at a target location, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s (unaffected by Resilience).

Kalea grabs an enemy hero with her tail and slams them down in the Joystick's direction (drag the Joystick to change landing spot). She gains Control Immunity during this process. Upon landing, deals 300<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and nearby enemies.

data.name: Kalea
data.story: With her serpent tail, this proud descendant of the Great Serpent swims gracefully through the Vonetis Sea, aspiring to one day carry the full power of her heritage.

assist.desc: Kalea's strong single-target CC makes her work well with heroes who have high single-target burst, like Eudora, Harley, and Clint.

strong.desc: Kalea counters heroes who lack mobility like Layla and Chang'e.

weak.desc: However, Kalea cannot grab enemies with Control Immunity, so heroes like Diggie and Minotaur can effectively counter her.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Lukas gains 0.5 Resolve per second and an additional 2 Resolve when attacking heroes.

Lukas consumes 10 Resolve per second while in [Sacred Beast] form.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Basic Attacks grant Vigor (up to 2 stacks), each stack lasting 4s. Vigor enhances <font color="a6aafb">Flash Combo</font>.
Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash Pulverize, dealing 220<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and recovering 5% of his Max HP when hitting a hero or minion.
<font color="a6aafb">1 Stack</font>: Lukas briefly stuns the target and spins his tonfa hammers to deal 100<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 3 times, pulling the enemy toward him.
<font color="a6aafb">2 Stacks</font>: Lukas briefly stuns the target, then delivers 2 attacks dealing 50<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each. Afterward, he spins his tonfa hammers, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 3 times while gaining Control Immunity for the duration.

Lukas dashes in the target direction and turns his next Basic Attack within 4s into <font color="a6aafb">Flash Strike</font>.
<font color="a6aafb">Flash Strike</font>: Lukas blinks behind the enemy, dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. He then gains increased Attack Range, 20% Movement Speed and Attack Speed, and his Basic Attacks trigger lightning storms to deal 50<font color="fba51f"> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, lasting for 4s.

Lukas transforms into his <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Beast</font> form (briefly gains Control Immunity). His base Movement Speed is increased by 30, all attributes are increased by 15%, and his skills gain new effects.
<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Fires a Shockwave Blast in the target direction that will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450<font color="fba51f"> (+155% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.
<font color="A4AAC7">All attributes: HP, Physical Attack, Attack Speed, Physical & Magic Defense, and Attack Range.</font>

Lukas gains 0.5 Resolve per second and an additional 2 Resolve when attacking heroes.

Lukas consumes 10 Resolve per second while in [Sacred Beast] form.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Basic Attacks grant Vigor (up to 2 stacks), each stack lasting 4s. Vigor enhances <font color="a6aafb">Flash Combo</font>.
Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash a tail swing, dealing 220<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and recovering 5% of his Max HP when hitting a hero.
<font color="a6aafb">1 Stack</font>: Lukas briefly stuns the target and pounces, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 3 times and knocking the enemy back.
<font color="a6aafb">2 Stacks</font>: Lukas briefly stuns the target and leaps, dealing 50<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 2 times. Afterward, he summons sacred lightning, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 3 times while gaining Control Immunity for the duration.

Lukas dashes in the target direction and turns his next Basic Attack within 4s into <font color="a6aafb">Lightning Clash</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Lightning Clash</font>: Lukas charges toward the enemy, knocking them back and dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. He then gains 20% Movement Speed and Attack Speed, and summons sacred lightning with Basic Attacks to deal 50<font color="fba51f"> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, lasting for 4s.

The Sacred Beast fires a Shockwave Blast in the target direction (gains Control Immunity during the cast) that will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450<font color="fba51f"> (+155% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

data.name: Lukas
data.story: A legendary Sacred Beast that can take the form of a rambunctious young man.

assist.desc: Lukas's Sacred Beast form has extended attack range and enhanced mobility, which synergizes well with heroes possessing AOE CC, such as Atlas, Tigreal, and Gatotkaca.

strong.desc: Lukas excels in close-quarter combat and is a good counter to heroes with low mobility and CC, like Hanabi and Ixia.

weak.desc: Lukas needs to stay close to enemies to deal damage, which makes him vulnerable to heroes with strong burst and CC, such as Fanny, Valir, and Julian.

skilllist.skilldesc:
<font color="a6aafb">Tap-casting</font> any skill will put Suyou in his Mortal form, granting him 40 Movement Speed and decreasing the interval between Basic Attacks.
<font color="a6aafb">Hold-casting</font> any skill will put Suyou in his Immortal form, increasing the damage of Basic Attacks to 125% and granting him 20% Physical Damage Reduction. In this form, for every 20 extra Physical Attack Suyou has, he gains 1% Physical Damage Reduction (up to 40%).

<font color="a6aafb">Tap</font>: Suyou throws his weapon in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path. Suyou then blinks to the weapon's location, catches it, and performs a slash in the opposite direction, dealing 375<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.
<font color="a6aafb">Hold</font>: Suyou channels the Immortal's power and charges in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the path. When hitting an enemy hero, he stops and stuns enemies in a rectangular area in front for 0.6s. The charge distance increases with the hold time.
<font color="A4AAC7">Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Tap</font>: Suyou performs a sweeping attack with his weapon, dealing <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 300<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> plus 15% of target's Lost HP to enemies in a fan-shaped area.
<font color="a6aafb">Hold</font>: Suyou channels the power of the Immortal to perform 3 cleaves in a fan-shaped area. The first two strikes deal 250<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each, while the final strike deals 400<font color="fba51f"> (+128% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and recovers 150<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</font> HP for himself.

<font color="a6aafb">Tap</font>: Suyou glides backward and swings his weapon in the target direction, dealing 420<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a rectangular area and on his path backward, and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s.
<font color="a6aafb">Hold</font>: Suyou uses the Immortal's power to shoot a deadly arrow in the target direction, dealing 580<font color="fba51f"> (+165% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target hit. The range increases with the hold time. 
<font color="A4AAC7">Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted</font>.

data.name: Suyou
data.story: An exorcist from Zhu'an who has inherited the power of the Immortal Nuo.

assist.desc: Heroes that provide control (like Tigreal) make it easier for Suyou to deal massive damage; heroes that provide recovery and extra movement speed (like Rafaela) help Suyou kite better.

strong.desc: Suyou's powerful long-range burst and pursuit abilities make it impossible for heroes without Blinks or Charges, such as Xavier and Ixia, to escape.

weak.desc: Because Suyou requires hold-casting skills, heroes with control can easily interrupt his attacks, such as Badang and Melissa.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage_92/100_595f85bc90df3889c711c6b1f02dc02d.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Every time Zhuxin channels <font color="a6aafb">Lantern Flare</font>, she converts the Mana spent into up to 15 <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Butterflies</font> to follow her <font color="a6aafb">Spirit Lantern</font>. After Zhuxin stops channeling <font color="a6aafb">Lantern Flare</font>, the <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Butterflies</font> will gradually disappear, each restoring 3% of her Max Mana.
Zhuxin has a naturally high base Max Mana, but it doesn't scale with her level.

Zhuxin deals 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies in a fan-shaped area and applies 1 stack(s) of <font color="a6aafb">Soul Snare</font>. Zhuxin also slows all enemy heroes hit by 20% and gains 20% of extra Movement Speed herself for 1.5s.

<font color="a6aafb">Hold</font>: Hold the skill button to move the <font color="a6aafb">Spirit Lantern</font>. It deals 35<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies in range every 0.33s (Magic Bonus increases to 60% against minions) and applies <font color="a6aafb">Soul Snare</font> to enemy heroes hit. When an enemy hero reaches 10 stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Soul Snare</font>, the <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Butterflies</font> capture them, pulling them airborne for 1s.

<font color="a6aafb">Release</font>: Throw all captured enemies to the target location, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 10% captured target's Max HP) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies in the area. If an enemy is hit multiple times, subsequent damage decays by 80%.

After a target is captured, <font color="a6aafb">Soul Snare</font> cannot stack on them again for 4s. During this time, this skill deals 15% extra damage to that target.

Zhuxin blinks to the target location, gaining a 400<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> shield and creating a field for 6s. The field deals 30<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and applies 1 stack of <font color="a6aafb">Soul Snare</font> to nearby enemies every 0.5s.

data.name: Zhuxin
data.story: A mysterious young woman who guides the ember butterflies using her Lantern of Spirits.

assist.desc: Zhuxin can provide great damage and CC, but she can't realize her potential until later in the game, so heroes with CC can help Zhuxin get through the early period. Zhuxin also works well with sustained damage heroes like Belerick, Kimmy, and Cici to dish out a surprising amount of damage.

strong.desc: Zhuxin is a good counter to enemies with less range and low mobility, such as Popol and Kupa and Cyclops, where she has a big advantage.

weak.desc: Like most Mages, Zhuxin is countered by heroes with high mobility and burst, such as Fanny and Saber, who can quickly take her down.

skilllist.skilldesc: Chip starts eating potato chips once every 2s when out of combat, regenerating HP equal to 300 plus 45% of lost HP after finishing a whole bag (requires 4 bites). After eating a bag of chips, Chip will be full and cannot eat again for 5s. (The bite count will be saved if he enters combat before finishing a whole bag.)

Chip rams his hovercraft into the ground, dealing <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 100 plus 4% of the target's Max HP and applying <font color="a6aafb">Chip's Mark</font> on enemy units hit. Chip gains a 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> Shield upon hitting an enemy hero, which increases by 40% for each additional enemy hero hit. Chip's next Basic Attack will become ranged and also hit all nearby enemies with <font color="a6aafb">Chip's Mark</font>, detonating the mark to deal 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and stun each target for 0.6s.

Chip rushes for 2s, gaining up to 65% extra Movement Speed, after which he maintains the max speed for 2s.

Chip's next Basic Attack will cause him to charge at the enemy, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and knocking them back slightly.

Chip drops the <font color="a6aafb">Main Portal</font> on an enemy hero, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and briefly slowing them by 25%. The Main Portal deals 2 times the damage and immobilizes them for 1s after a delay. Meanwhile, he creates <font color="a6aafb">Connecting Portals</font> near allied heroes 10 units away and behind the allied Base. The <font color="a6aafb">Main Portal</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Connecting Portals</font> last up to 15s.
<font color="a6aafb">Connecting Portal</font>: Heroes (on both teams) can teleport from <font color="a6aafb">Connecting Portals</font> to the <font color="a6aafb">Main Portal</font>, and allied heroes gain Burst Movement Speed for 1.5s and a 500 shield.
<font color="a6aafb">Main Portal</font>: The Main Portal inherits 70% of Chip's attributes. Heroes can stand on the <font color="a6aafb">Main Portal</font> for 2s to return to the <font color="a6aafb">Connecting Portal</font> they came from. Casting skills or launching Basic Attacks will reset the stand time.

Chip has 4 fixed <font color="a6aafb">Beacons</font> on the map when the battle starts. Use this skill to teleport to any other <font color="a6aafb">Beacon</font>. (This skill cannot be used in combat.)

data.name: Chip
data.story: A carefree, genetically enhanced fox that wields advanced portal technology.

assist.desc: Chip's Ultimate allows his team to group up from anywhere, so he works well with heroes who can't cross the map quickly but excel in teamfights, such as Alpha, Hanabi, and Kadita.

strong.desc: Chip possesses strong initiation and CC abilities, making him a great counter against heroes with low mobility or those who are relatively squishy, such as Vexana, Layla, and Ixia.

weak.desc: Since enemies can also use Chip's Connecting Portals, certain heroes with strong teamfighting abilities, like Barats and Tigreal, can use them to their advantage.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_60e3e11da30f404c77fff9e22d3bdc72.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Cici generates a stack of Delight after dealing damage, increasing her Movement Speed by 0.75% and Spell Vamp by 0.75% per stack up to 10 times, doubling the effects at full stacks.

Cici uses Yoyo to continuously attack the nearest enemy within range (prioritizing heroes) for 3.5s, hitting them up to 10 times, and dealing <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 65 plus 3<font color="fba51f"> (+1.2% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of the target's Max HP per hit. Cici can move and use other skills during this attack.

If there is no enemy within range, Yoyo will attack Turrets or the Base instead.

This skill deals 20% extra damage to Minions.

Cici leaps to a target location. If she lands on any unit (not including Turrets and Base), she can leap again in the Joystick's direction. If she lands on an enemy with the first leap, she deals 200<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to them.

Cici throws Yoyo at the target enemy hero and links them with another nearby enemy hero, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+10% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, slowing them by 30%, and pulling them together for 4s. 

During this time, Cici can use <font color="a6aafb">Yo-Yo Blitz</font> to attack both linked targets at the same time. If only one target is within the range of <font color="a6aafb">Yo-Yo Blitz</font>, Cici will attack the target twice, but the damage of the second attack will be reduced to 25%.

data.name: Cici
data.story: A cheerful performer who spreads fun and wonderment wherever she goes.

assist.desc: Cici works well with heroes that have buffs and can boost survivability. Supports like Angela and Floryn can help Cici gain an early advantage by greatly amplifying her combat capabilities to end the game before it drags on too long.

strong.desc: Because of Cici's great kiting ability and her 1st Skill dealing Max HP damage, Cici counters certain Tanks like Fredrinn and Minotaur.

weak.desc: Cici is countered by heroes with targeted CC skills who can stop her dead in her tracks, such as Saber and Kaja.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_9012ee9f73fbb4db4e1953e5fb5172e1.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Nolan's skills will leave a <font color="a6aafb">Rift</font>. When a rift comes into contact with another rift, they will <font color="a6aafb">activate</font> and pull enemies to their center and deal 240<font color="fba51f"> (+140% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> after a short delay. Each time a rift activation hits an enemy, Nolan will gain 20 Energy. If an enemy is hit by multiple rift activations, the damage after the first hit will be reduced by 40%.
<font color="a6aafb">Cosmic Leap</font>: If Nolan does not deal or take damage for 5s, he enhances his next Basic Attack to dash to the target, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and leaving a <font color="a6aafb">Rift</font>. (Damage to and from Minions or Creeps will not prevent Nolan from getting this effect.)

Nolan cuts a rectangular area in front of him with his cosmic gauge, dealing 230<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and leaving a <font color="a6aafb">Rift</font> at the first enemy hit.

Nolan charges in the target direction and slashes with his cosmic gauge, dealing 70<font color="fba51f"> (+13% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in his path and leaving a <font color="a6aafb">Rift</font>.

Nolan slashes at the target location 3 times, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> with each slash while leaving 3 rifts and slowing the target hit by 30% for 0.5s. The rifts will be activated automatically while Nolan dashes backward.

data.name: Nolan
data.story: A scholar that wanders the universe with split souls to save his daughter.

assist.desc: Nolan works well with Tanks that can initiate and CC the enemy so Nolan to focus on dealing as much damage as possible, such as Tigreal and Gatotkaca.

strong.desc: Nolan counters squishy heroes that lack mobility skills like Hanabi and Eudora because they have a hard time avoiding his rifts while Nolan's own mobility makes them easy targets.

weak.desc: Nolan is countered by tanky heroes with high sustained damage, such as Thamuz and Fredrinn, who can survive Nolan's burst and kill him afterwards.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Starlium Charge</font> to enemies on hit. When Ixia performs a Basic Attack on an enemy with two stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Starlium Charge</font>, the attack consumes the stacks and is replaced by <font color="a6aafb">Siphon Starlium</font>, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="26e407">(+200 Lifesteal)</font> +(+10*Hero Level) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target. Ixia recovers HP equal to the damage dealt (only 10<font color="26e407">(+150 Lifesteal)</font>% against non-hero units) and slows the target by 25% for 1s.
<font color="a6aafb">Siphon Starlium</font> can hit all enemies in front of Ixia within her Basic Attack range, but it cannot Crit.
Ixia's Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal.

Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a rectangular area. When hitting enemy heroes, Ixia gains 50% Movement Speed for 2s.
Enemies hit by both beams will take double damage.

Ixia unleashes a canister of Starlium energy in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies. After a short delay, it pulls enemies in range to the center line and deals 200<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

Ixia reassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the <font color="a6aafb">Full Barrage</font> state for 4s. In this state, Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills can hit enemies in the large fan-shaped area in front of her, but not outside it. Ixia's Basic Attacks can hit up to 6 enemy units (prioritizes heroes), and <font color="a6aafb">Siphon Starlium</font> will fire simultaneously with her normal Basic Attacks.

data.name: Ixia
data.story: The leader of Bad Soul and self-proclaimed inventor, she wields a homemade weapon powered by a stolen Starlium reactor.

assist.desc: With her Ultimate, Ixia is capable of dealing impressive sustained damage. So she works best with heroes with area CC abilities, like Atlas and Vexana.

strong.desc: Ixia's skills make her a nice kiter. She works well against heroes with short ranges or poor Slow abilities, such as Fredrinn and Bane.

weak.desc: Ixia lacks survivability, that's why she can be countered by heroes with high burst damage or strong control abilities such as Saber and Aamon.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Arlott possesses a demonic eye that will <font color="a6aafb">Mark</font> enemy units near Arlott that become affected by control effects for 7s.
The eye will also automatically <font color="a6aafb">Mark</font> a nearby enemy hero in vision every 7s.

Arlott swings his lance forward, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and briefly stunning targets in an area. Targets hit by the farther part of the AOE will be stunned for 1s instead.

Arlott charges at an enemy, dealing 135<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (this skill cannot be interrupted during movement).
If Arlott's target is <font color="a6aafb">Marked</font>, he gains a brief burst of Movement Speed, and this skill will deal double damage, immediately refresh its cooldown, and recover 70<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP to Arlott (only restores 50% of that amount when used on a non-hero unit).

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Each level-up reduces <font color="a6aafb">Demon Gaze</font>'s interval by 1s.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Arlott cleaves forward, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area, knocking them back to the edge of the swing, and briefly revealing their location (can only be interrupted by Suppression).

data.name: Arlott
data.story: A demon human hybrid wielding two lances with a thirst for vengeance against both the Church and demons.

assist.desc: Arlott works well with Tanks who can initiate with CC, such as Gatotkaca and Atlas. Their CC will also mark enemies for Arlott, allowing him to use his 2nd Skill even more for tons of damage.

strong.desc: Arlott counters Fighters with relatively lower HP, such as Sun and Zilong. Arlott can deal high burst damage and has excellent chasing and control abilities, allowing him to quickly eliminate more fragile Fighters.

weak.desc: Arlott is countered by tanky Fighters that can withstand lots of damage, like Thamuz and Fredrinn, because he lacks the burst to take them out quickly and will lose in a prolonged battle.

skilllist.skilldesc: <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font> continuously slows nearby enemies by 20% and reveals their position.

Novaria summons an <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font> at the target location, dealing 75<font color="62f8fe"> (+25% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.33s and continuously slowing enemies (up to 2.5 times). After 2s, the <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font> explodes, dealing 260<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 4% target's Max HP) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing enemies by 2.5 times.

Novaria summons an <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font> at a distance and draws it toward her. She gains 20% Movement Speed and can pass through terrain. Movement Speed boost increases to 60% while passing through terrain.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Upon catching the <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font>, she can cast <font color="a6aafb">Star Shatter</font> to launch it in the target direction within 5s. The sphere will explode when hitting an enemy hero, dealing 230<font color="62f8fe"> (+90% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 4% target's Max HP) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. The damage will increase based on the <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font>'s travel distance (draw + launch), up to 2.5 times the original damage.

Novaria scatters <font color="a6aafb">Astral Echo</font> in the target direction, briefly slowing enemy heroes hit by 50% and applying <font color="a6aafb">Astral Ring</font> on them. This increases their hitbox by 2.5 times and reveals their position for 5s.

data.name: Novaria
data.story: The young girl who seeks to rebuild the Star Atlas in order to solve the secrets of the Stars.

assist.desc: Novaria works well with other long-range heroes like Beatrix and Layla because her Ultimate makes any target a sitting duck for her team to pick off.

strong.desc: Novaria counters Mages with shorter range and low mobility, such as Eudora and Odette, because these heroes can't reach Novaria while Novaria can hit them with her 2nd Skill.

weak.desc: Novaria is countered by Assassins with strong targeted burst damage, such as Saber and Hayabusa, because they can easily close in on Novaria and burst her down.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Joy becomes <font color="a6aafb">Angry!</font> each time her skill hits a non-Minion enemy, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and increasing her Movement Speed by 60% that decays over 4s (hitting the <font color="a6aafb">Leonin Crystal</font> will also grant the Movement Speed effect). This effect has a cooldown of 4s for each target.

Joy's Basic Attack will deal 65<font color="fba51f"> (+65% Total Physical Attack)</font>  <font color="62f8fe">(+65% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

Joy summons a <font color="a6aafb">Leonin Crystal</font> at the target location, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The <font color="a6aafb">Leonin Crystal</font> lasts up to 2s.

Joy dashes in the target direction, dealing 120<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the <font color="a6aafb">Leonin Crystal</font> allows Joy to cast this skill again within 0.8s and gain 1 <font color="a6aafb">Beat Energy</font>. Casting this skill on the beat increases the skill damage by 100% and grants a 80<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> shield that lasts 3s.

This skill can be cast up to 4 times in succession.

Joy increases her Physical & Magic Defense by 15<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> and gains 30% Movement Speed. Over the next 3s, she pulses 8 times, dealing 120<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> each time to nearby enemies.
Each <font color="a6aafb">Meow, Rhythm of Joy!</font> cast on the beat increases this skill's damage by 40%. If perfect rhythm is achieved by hitting every beat with <font color="a6aafb">Meow, Rhythm of Joy!</font>, Joy also gains 40% Spell Vamp while this skill is active.
This skill unlocks when Joy acquires <font color="a6aafb">Beat Energy</font>. Casting this skill with 3 <font color="a6aafb">Beat Energy</font> will remove all debuffs on Joy and make her immune to slow effects while this skill is active.

data.name: Joy
data.story: The "Child of Miracle" who returned to the Leonins after years of wandering.

assist.desc: Joy works best with heroes with that can provide powerful support or have strong initiation, like Angela and Hylos.

strong.desc: Joy is strong against heroes that lack mobility or rely on CC, like Xavier and Vexana, because she has an easier time hitting them with her 2nd Skill while being immune to their CC's.

weak.desc: Joy is countered by heroes that can restrict mobility skills, such as Minsitthar and Khufra, due to her kit's heavy reliance on her 2nd Skill.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Fredrinn gains 1 <font color="a6aafb">Combo Point</font> that lasts 5s each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy, up to 4 <font color="a6aafb">Combo Points</font>. His Ultimates cost different numbers of <font color="a6aafb">Combo Points</font>.

Fredrinn stores 100% of the damage he receives as <font color="a6aafb">Crystal Energy</font>, which decays after 5s at a rate of 10% Max HP per second.
Fredrinn can convert the stored <font color="a6aafb">Crystal Energy</font> into HP by 20% of his damage dealt (10% for damage dealt to minions). Gaining a <font color="a6aafb">Combo Point</font> resets the decaying timer.

Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the target direction, dealing 125<font color="26e407"> (+7% Total HP)</font> <font color="fba51f">(+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s. His next Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 85<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.
This skill deals 200% damage to non-hero enemies.

Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first non-minion enemy hit. His next Basic Attack knocks the target airborne for 0.3s.

Fredrinn deals 210<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1s. Hitting a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn 25 Physical & Magic Defense for 3s and reduces the cooldowns of <font color="a6aafb">Piercing Strike</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Brave Assault</font> by 75%.
This skill costs 1 <font color="a6aafb">Combo Point</font>.

Fredrinn slams his sword in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 600 plus 21% of his <font color="a6aafb">Crystal Energy</font> as <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area after a short delay. Enemies in the center of the area take 175% damage. This skill doubles the conversion ratio based on damage dealt to enemy heroes from stored <font color="a6aafb">Crystal Energy</font> to HP.
This skill costs 3 <font color="a6aafb">Combo Points</font>.

data.name: Fredrinn
data.story: A master treasure appraiser in Los Pecados accumulating wealth and searching for his lost friend.

assist.desc: Fredrinn works best with support heroes, who can further improve his survivability, like Angela and Floryn.

strong.desc: Fredrinn is strong against Mage heroes who rely on skill bursts, as it is difficult for them to one-shot him with their bursts. Instead, once Fredrinn has enough Combo Points, he can use his 2nd Ultimate to easily finish them off. Such as Vale and Eudora.

weak.desc: Fredrinn is countered by Marksman heroes who can deal True Damage, as they can take him down very easily. Heroes like Kerrie and Lesley are good examples here.

data.name: Julian
data.story: A Raven assassin of the Church of Light, a young boy who's in search of his home…

assist.desc: Julian works best with powerful support heroes who can buff him, like Angela and Diggie.

strong.desc: Julian is a hero who can constantly grow his own advantage, so he is strong against heroes who are weak in the early game, like Cecilion and Aldous.

weak.desc: Julian needs to hit enemy heroes with his skills to bring out his potential, so he is countered by heroes with good Mobility. Such as Joy and Harith.

skilllist.skilldesc:
When Xavier's skills hit enemy heroes, he gains 50% Movement Speed for 1.2s (decays over time) and 1 energy charge. At 3 charges, his next skill triggers the Transcendence state.

<font color="a6aafb">Transcendence:</font> In this state, Xavier's Skills 1 and 2 have their cooldowns reduced by 4s, and his Ultimate by 36s. Transcendence lasts 5s and can be extended by 1s each time his skills hit enemies.

Xavier fires a Mystic Bullet that deals 480<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies it passes through.

The Bullet's flying distance increases each time it hits an enemy or the <font color="a6aafb">Mystic Barrier</font> (up to 5 times).

Xavier conjures a <font color="a6aafb">Mystic Barrier</font> that lasts 5s. When hit by Xavier's other skills, the Barrier expands into a <font color="a6aafb">Mystic Field</font> for 3s, dealing 220<font color="62f8fe"> (+65% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within and immobilizing them for 0.8s.

Xavier unleashes a beam of Mystic magic in the target direction, dealing 600<font color="62f8fe"> (+180% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies along its path.

Once cast, he also directly enters the <font color="a6aafb">Transcendence</font> state and resets the state's duration.

data.name: Xavier
data.story: Former member of the Knights of Light who's determined to forge a path of his own.

assist.desc: He works well alongside heroes that can buff or provide CC to give him more opportunities to deal damage, such as Carmilla and Atlas.

strong.desc: Xavier possesses short cooldowns, a soft CC, good sustainability and performs well against heroes without Blink or burst damage, such as Hanabi and Faramis.

weak.desc: Xavier is countered by heroes with high mobility that can quickly close a gap such as Benedetta, Hayabusa, and Natalia.

Enemies attempting to enter the field are knocked back, taking 50<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowed briefly. assist.desc:
Tanks that can chain CC such as Tigreal and Minotaur,
allowing her to keep enemies linked.

data.name: Yin
data.story: A young martial artist on a journey to defeat the Evil God that dwells within him.

assist.desc: Yin works best with Supports that can enhance his mobility, such as Mathilda and Rafaela to help him get to the enemy and eliminate key targets.

data.name: Edith

strong.desc: Beatrix is strong against heroes without movement abilities, as they can be easily hit by her skills, such as Hylos and Belerick.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Gloo's skills apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Sticky</font> to enemies on hit, decreasing their Movement Speed by 4% for 6s (up to 5 stacks).
Each <font color="a6aafb">Sticky</font> stack on an attacker reduces their damage dealt to Gloo by 3%.

Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing 80<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit.
A <font color="a6aafb">Goo</font> is left at the end location, which explodes after 3s, dealing 300<font color="26e407"> (+12% Extra Max HP)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and immobilizing them for 1s.
Touching the <font color="a6aafb">Goo</font> detonates it immediately and resets this skill's cooldown. Gloo also recovers 2.5% Max HP if the explosion hits an enemy (doubled if it hits an enemy hero).

Gloo splits into <font color="a6aafb">Goos</font>, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area and immobilizing them for 0.5s. For the next 4s, Gloo gains 10% Movement Speed and deals 80<font color="62f8fe"> (+15% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.25s to enemies it touches.
If this skill hits a <font color="a6aafb">Goo</font>, Gloo charges toward it, dragging enemies in its path along for a distance.

Unlocked when an enemy hero reaches max <font color="a6aafb">Sticky</font> stacks. Gloo attaches itself to the target for up to 9s, recovering 25% Max HP.

While attached, Gloo's Basic Attacks deal 30<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="26e407"> (+6% Extra Max HP)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, and it transfers 80% of the damage it takes (excluding Turret damage) to the host. If the host dies while Gloo is attached, this skill's cooldown is reduced to 5s.

data.name: Gloo
data.story: A magical amalgamation of cute, mischievous creatures that dwells deep in the Shadow Swamp.

assist.desc: Gloo works best with high burst damage heroes, as they can quickly take down the enemy hero that he brings back with his Ultimate. Like Eudora and Saber.

strong.desc: Gloo is strong against Mage heroes without good CC. Because he can easily attach himself to them, and take them where he wants them to go. Such as Cecilion and Chang'e.

weak.desc: Gloo is countered by Marksman heroes with good mobility. It's difficult for Gloo to attach himself to them, and he can easily be killed if he tries. Such as Karrie and Lesley.

skilllist.skilldesc:
After every 3 skill casts, Paquito enters the <font color="a6aafb">Champ Stance</font>, gaining an enhanced skill ignoring his current cooldowns. He gains 60% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.8s after casting the enhanced skill.
Paquito's Basic Attacks only deal <font color="fba51f"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

Paquito throws a punch in the target direction, dealing 210<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit. If this skill hits an enemy hero or Creep, Paquito will also gain a 150<font color="fba51f"> (+135% Total Physical Attack)</font> shield for 2.5s.

<font color="a6aafb">Champ Stance</font>: The damage is increased to 350<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and the shield value is increased to 140%. The normal and enhanced shields can stack.

Paquito dashes in the target direction and throws a jab, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+165% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit. Paquito will stop and throw the jab immediately upon colliding with an enemy hero or Creep during the dash.

<font color="a6aafb">Champ Stance</font>: The damage is increased to 350<font color="fba51f"> (+230% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

Paquito launches an elbow strike in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and knocking them back. He then throws a haymaker, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 75% for 1s, as he darts backward.

<font color="a6aafb">Champ Stance</font>: Instead of a haymaker, Paquito launches an uppercut after the elbow strike, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.5s.

data.name: Paquito
data.story: The hero who uses his two fists to protect hope and love.

assist.desc: Paquito works best with support heroes who can buff him, like Angela and Rafaela.

strong.desc: Paquito is a hero with dash and high burst damage, making him strong against squishy heroes without defensive abilities, such as Gord and Layla.

weak.desc: Paquito is an agile hero, but he is also kind of squishy, which makes him weak against heroes with strong CC abilities. Such as Franco and Kaja.

skilllist.skilldesc: Mathilda gains <font color="a6aafb">Ancestral Guidance</font> while moving. When it's fully charged, her next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the target and granting her 80 extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.

Mathilda resonates with the power of her ancestors for 4s, attracting wisps as her movement distance increases (up to 6 wisps).

At the end of the skill's duration, or when Mathilda casts this skill again, the wisps will seek and attack nearby enemies, each dealing 275<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and revealing the enemies' positions briefly. Subsequent damage dealt by wisps to the same target decays to 40%.

Mathilda leaps in the target direction and creates a field around her, gaining a 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+180% Total Magic Power)</font> shield and 25% extra Movement Speed for 3s. Allied heroes who come into contact with the field will receive a 50% shield and <font color="a6aafb">Guiding Wind</font>. The first allied hero that triggers <font color="a6aafb">Guiding Wind</font> will be guided to Mathilda, and both of them will gain the same Movement Speed boost.

When casting this skill during <font color="a6aafb">Circling Eagle</font>, Mathilda won't change her position.
<font color="a6aafb">Guiding Wind</font> expires 2s after the hero leaves Mathilda's field.

Mathilda applies a <font color="a6aafb">Soul Mark</font> to the target enemy hero and circles around them for up to 3.5s, during which her wisps will fly into nearby enemies, each dealing 40<font color="62f8fe"> (+15% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. The Soul Mark will also slow the target by 15% and <font color="a6aafb">Soul Bloom</font> will prioritize the target with Soul Mark.
Within the duration, Mathilda can select an area to dash to. At the end of the duration, she'll dash at the target with <font color="a6aafb">Soul Mark</font>, dealing 320<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> while knocking enemies in her path airborne for 0.6s, transferring the <font color="a6aafb">Soul Mark</font> to the first enemy hero that she knocks airborne, and reducing the skill cooldown by 40%.
Mathilda gains Control Immunity and a 400<font color="62f8fe"> (+160% Total Magic Power)</font> shield for the skill duration.

data.name: Mathilda
data.story: A brave girl who stands up and doesn't fear power.

assist.desc: Mathilda works well with high burst damage heroes who can use Guiding Wind and follow up her Ultimate to secure kills, such as Saber and Eudora.

strong.desc: Mathilda excels in harassment and single-target CC, making her a great counter to squishy heroes with no escape skills, like Gord and Vale.

weak.desc: Mathilda is countered by Tanks with multiple CC skills, such as Franco and Minsitthar.

skilllist.skilldesc: When Yve deals damage to enemy heroes with her skills, she gains Galactic Power (cooldown: 0.5s), up to 3 stacks. Each stack provides Yve with a 120(+10*Hero Level)<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> shield for 3s.

Yve detonates Galactic Energy at the target location, dealing 290<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in the area.
Successfully hitting an enemy grants Yve 55% extra Movement Speed (halved if a non-hero enemy is hit) that decreases over 1s.

Yve summons a <font color="a6aafb">Void Crystal</font> at the target location, dealing 220<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Yve commands the Crystal to fire materialized energy in the target direction for 2.7s, dealing 75<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.45s to enemies hit and slowing them by 20%. Enemies hit multiple times are slowed by an extra 4% for each hit after the first hit (up to 40%).

Yve creates a Starfield that lasts 15s. Within the duration, you can Tap or Swipe the screen to attack up to 20 times.
<font color="a6aafb">Tap</font>: Deals 340<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in the target area.
<font color="a6aafb">Swipe</font>: Deals 85<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.45s to enemies in the target area for 2.7s and slows them by 40%.
Enemies leaving or entering the Starfield will be immobilized for 0.8s (only once against the same target).
Yve cannot be displaced while the Starfield is active, and the Starfield will remain even if Yve is controlled (except for Suppression).

data.name: Yve
data.story: Keeper of the equilibrium of the universe.

assist.desc: Yve's works best with Tanks and Supports with strong CC to lockdown enemies for her Ultimate, like Minotaur, Gatotkaca, and Atlas.

strong.desc: Yve counters Tanks and Fighters with low mobility like Fredrinn, Barats, and Aulus due to her long range skills.

weak.desc: Yve's low survivability makes her a target for divers and burst damage heroes like Yin, Saber, and Karina.

skilllist.skilldesc:
With his Basic Attacks resonated with the Abyss Power within his body, Brody is able to move while winding up his Basic Attacks (which will be interrupted when casting skills), at the cost of having longer Basic Attack Animation and lower Attack Speed Bonus. Each Basic Attack deals <font color="fba51f"> (+140% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="ffe63c">(+45*Hero Level)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (of which the damage scaling with level cannot be critical), increases Movement Speed by 30% (which will decay rapidly in 1.2s), and applies 1 stack of <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Mark</font> on the enemy, capped at 4 stacks.
Each stack of <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Mark</font> increases Brody's damage against the target by 5% and his Movement Speed by 5%.

Brody launches a shockwave in the target direction, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+170% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing enemies by 30% for 1.2s while applying one stack of <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Mark</font>.

For each enemy hit by the shockwave, they take an extra 5% slow and one extra <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Mark</font> stack (capped at 45% slow and 4 stacks).

Brody dashes to an enemy, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target, stunning the target for 0.8s, and applying 1 stack of <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Mark</font> on the target.
Upon hitting the target, he is able to move one more time in the movement direction, gaining 45% Movement Speed that will decay rapidly in 1.2s.

Brody locks on all the targets within 8 unit(s), dealing 216<font color="fba51f"> (+165% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to them. If the target has an <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Mark</font>, all <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Marks</font> will be reset, dealing <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 94<font color="fba51f"> (+72% Extra Physical Attack)</font> plus 4% of the target's lost HP for each stack the target has.

data.name: Brody
data.story: Mysterious man whose right hand was corroded and who lost his memory.

assist.desc: Brody works best with heroes who can perform lock-on attacks or heroes with area CC abilities, as they can give Brody more room to deal damage and farm better. Such as Hylos and Minsitthar.

strong.desc: Brody is strong against heroes with poor survivability in the early game and heroes without dash, because he can easily lock on them and attack beyond their reach. Like Aamon and Yin.

weak.desc: Brody is countered by heroes with CC immunity and multiple movement abilities, because they can quickly close in on Brody, giving him no chance to stack the Abyss Mark. Such as Martis and Wanwan.

skilllist.skilldesc: Detona gains a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Big Guy</font> for 12s each time it or Barats damages an enemy with their skills (up to 10 stacks). Each stack of <font color="a6aafb">Big Guy</font> increases Detona's size and grants 4-10 extra Hybrid Defense (scales with the level of <font color="a6aafb">Detona's Welcome</font>). At max stacks, Detona gains 20% extra Resilience, and its Basic Attacks are replaced with <font color="a6aafb">Trample</font>, which deals <font color="fba51f"> (+140% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="26e407">(+3.5% Total HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a circular area, slows them by 40% for 0.2s, and refreshes the duration of <font color="a6aafb">Big Guy</font> with each hit.

Detona spits contaminated oil in the target direction, dealing 60<font color="26e407"> (+7% Total HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Barats then ignites the oil with a firecracker, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+180% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area (only 50% damage to Creeps).

The area of effect of <font color="a6aafb">So-Called Teamwork</font> increases with the number of <font color="a6aafb">Big Guy</font> stacks.

Barats fires two missiles at the target location, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing enemies by 40% for 1s. The missiles expel fumes from their exhausts upon landing, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a rectangular area and pushing them toward Barats.

After a short delay, Detona charges in the target direction, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="26e407">(+1.2% Total HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit, devouring and suppressing them for 1.2s, then spitting them out. If the spat‑out target hits an enemy hero or a wall, it triggers an explosion. The target and nearby enemies take an additional 180<font color="fba51f"> (+105% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="26e407">(+5% Total HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and are stunned for 1s.

During the skill, Barats becomes immune to control effects. If the cast is canceled or the skill misses, 50% of the skill cooldown is refunded.
If Detona successfully devours an enemy, he immediately gains max stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Big Guy</font>.

data.name: Barats
data.story: Adventurer riding a dragon lizard.

assist.desc: Barats works best with Supports who can give him Movement Speed to make up for his lack of mobility, such as Mathilda and Angela.

strong.desc: Barats counters Tank heroes that rely on CC skills, such as Belerick and Lolita, since the extra Resilience provided by his Passive will greatly reduce the duration of their CC.

weak.desc: Barats is countered by agile Marksmen who can deal high damage to Tanks, such as Karrie and Moskov, because Barats lacks mobility and his skills can be avoided, making these heroes very difficult to kill.

skilllist.skilldesc: Khaleed accumulates <font color="a6aafb">Desert Power</font> while moving. After <font color="a6aafb">Desert Power</font> is fully charged, he will glide on sand, increasing Movement Speed by 35%, making his next Basic Attack deal 50<font color="fba51f"> (+140% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target (cannot Crit), and reducing the target's Movement Speed by 40% for 1.5s.

Khaleed whirls his scimitar, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+140% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and pulling them toward him. This skill can be used up to 3 time(s) in a row.

This skill deals 50% damage to Minions and Creeps.

Khaleed protects himself with the power of the quicksand, restoring 60 plus 5% of his lost HP and 10 <font color="a6aafb">Desert Power</font> every 0.5s, reducing damage taken by 25% for up to 4s.

While channeling, quicksand appears under his feet, slowing the enemy by 60%.
This skill is a Focused Cast. Any other controls will interrupt this skill.

Khaleed rides the sandstorm and charges toward a designated location, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way and knocking them toward his destination. Khaleed is immune to control effects during this process.

Upon reaching the destination, Khaleed will smash the ground, dealing 450<font color="fba51f"> (+160% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and stunning them for 1s, and fully charge his <font color="a6aafb">Desert Power</font>.

data.name: Khaleed
data.story: A sand-walking intrepid Clan leader.

assist.desc: Because Khaleed can deal a lot of AOE damage, he works well with heroes like Roger and Karina who excel at finishing off multiple low HP targets.

strong.desc: Khaleed counters heroes who lack mobility like Cyclops and Xavier since they will have difficult time avoiding his combo.

weak.desc: Khaleed is countered by heroes who have the ability to knock him back or airborne to interrupt his 2nd Skill, such as X.Borg and Chou.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Hold the <font color="a6aafb">Basic Attack</font> button to enter the <font color="a6aafb">Swordout</font> state and charge Sword Intent. Once fully charged, release it to perform a Swordout Slash in <font color="a6aafb">the direction she's facing</font> and dash forward, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+215% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies on the path (counts as skill damage and is reduced to 50% against minions and creeps).

Benedetta can only cast Swordout Slash when her Sword Intent is full and she is in the <font color="a6aafb">Swordout</font> state.

Benedetta also gains Sword Intent by dealing damage with her Basic Attacks and skills.

Benedetta withdraws swiftly and leaves a shadow in front. After a short delay, her shadow slashes forward in a fan-shaped area, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing the enemies by 60% for 0.5s.

Meanwhile, Benedetta dashes forward to slash, dealing 75<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. (If the target is hit by her shadow, damage caused by Benedetta herself will increase to 200%.)

Benedetta raises her weapon to defend, gaining Control Immunity and blocking damage from any source for 0.8s. After this, she stabs in the designated direction, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

If Benedetta successfully fends off any damage while defending, she will gain full <font color="a6aafb">Sword Intent</font>. If she fends off any control effects, her subsequent stab stuns the target for 1.5s.

Benedetta clenches Alecto, dashes forward (Benedetta is untargetable during the dash), and performs a slash after a short delay, detonating the Sword Intent along the path. For 2.5s, the Sword Intent deals up to a total of 1560<font color="fba51f"> (+1105% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within and slows them by 50%.

data.name: Benedetta
data.story: Female warrior defending the Barren Lands against demon invasion.

assist.desc: Benedetta works well with strong CC initiators, like Johnson and Gatotkaca, because they allow her to maximize the effects of her Ultimate.

strong.desc: Benedetta's 2nd Skill can effectively block enemy CC, making her a great counter to heroes with predictable CC skills, such as Jawhead and Guinevere.

weak.desc: Benedetta is countered by heroes with skills that shutdown mobility skills, such as Minsitthar and Phoveus, since all of Benedetta's skills are considered mobility.
