skilllist.skilldesc:
Luo Yi's skills can create <font color="a6aafb">Sigils of Yin/Yang</font> on the battlefield. Each Sigil lasts up to 6s.
Sigils of opposite attributes will trigger <font color="a6aafb">Yin-Yang Reaction</font> when they are within a certain distance, dealing 300 (+25*Hero Level) <font color="62f8fe">(+190% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the marked enemies, stunning them for 0.3s, and pulling them toward each other.
Each time Luo Yi applies a new Sigil to a marked enemy, she gains a 300 (+10*Hero Level) <font color="62f8fe">(+150% Total Magic Power)</font> shield (up to 3 stacks) and 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2s.

Luo Yi casts the energy of <font color="a6aafb">Yin/Yang</font> in the target direction, dealing 285<font color="62f8fe"> (+135% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and those behind them in a fan-shaped area. Enemy heroes hit are marked with a <font color="a6aafb">Sigil of Yin/Yang</font>.
Luo Yi stores up to 4 <font color="a6aafb">Dispersion</font> charges and gains 1 charge every 8s. She also immediately gains 1 charge each time <font color="a6aafb">Yin-Yang Reaction</font> is triggered.
The state of this skill changes on each cast.

Luo Yi summons <font color="a6aafb">Fire of Yang / Aqua of Yin</font> at the target location, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s.
<font color="a6aafb">Fire of Yang / Aqua of Yin</font> then remains at the location for 6s, dealing 50<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.7s to nearby enemies. It can also trigger <font color="a6aafb">Yin-Yang Reaction</font> with Sigils of opposite attributes.
The state of this skill changes on each cast.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Luo Yi's Cooldown Reduction is increased by 6%.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Luo Yi creates a Teleport Circle around herself and marks the target location (within 28 units) as its destination. After a 3s delay, allied heroes within the Circle will be teleported to the location.

data.name: Luo Yi
data.story: Seeking to revive an ancient past, she is the sole being who has mastered the secrets of Yin and Yang.

assist.desc: Luo Yi works best with Junglers who are often looking for fights around the map, such as Aamon and Karina, because she can use her Ultimate to cut down their travel time.

strong.desc: Luo Yi counters heroes with low mobility such as Eudora and Gord because they are easy targets for her Sigils and Yin-Yang Reactions.

weak.desc: Luo Yi is countered by Fighters or Tanks with high HP recovery like Uranus and Fredrinn because she can't deal enough damage to finish them off quickly.

skilllist.skilldesc: Yu Zhong applies <font color="a6aafb">Sha Residue</font> to enemy heroes every time he deals damage to them. <font color="a6aafb">Sha Residue</font> erupts upon reaching 5 stacks on a target. Then it begins consuming 1 stack every 0.4s to deal <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 20<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Extra Physical Attack)</font> plus 2.5% of the target's lost HP to the target. Each stack consumed restores 6% of Yu Zhong's lost HP. When <font color="a6aafb">Sha Residue</font> erupts, Yu Zhong also gains 30% Movement Speed for 3s.

Yu Zhong infuses his power into his cloak and turns it into a weapon, which starts to attack nearby enemies after a short delay. The inner area of the cloak deals 220<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, whereas the sharpened edge deals 275% damage and applies 2 stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Sha Residue</font>.

Yu Zhong unleashes the Dragon Soul, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to all enemies in front and slowing them by 60% for 1s. 

Upon hitting an enemy, Yu Zhong's next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 108<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Upon hitting multiple enemies, the enhanced Basic Attack will apply multiple stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Sha Residue</font> and deal up to 200% damage.

Yu Zhong leaps towards the designated area with his full strength, dealing 180<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. He is able to dash one more time in the movement direction. 
After a short delay, enemies within the area of effect will be knocked airborne for 0.6s and take 180<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Extra Physical Attack)</font> additional <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

After channeling for 0.6s, Yu Zhong transforms into his Black Dragon Form. For up to 7s, he cannot use any skills but can move freely and will knock back enemy heroes in his path while dealing 180<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. He also gains 1000<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> Max HP, becomes immune to control effects, and ignores obstacles in this form.
Upon exiting the Black Dragon Form, Yu Zhong enters <font color="a6aafb">Dragonoid Form</font>, gaining increased range on all of his skills for 10s.

data.name: Yu Zhong
data.story: Yu Zhong, the reincarnation of the Black Dragon, intends to unify the Cadia Riverlands through conquest and usher in an era of prosperity.

assist.desc: Yu Zhong works well with Mages that can initiate with CC such as Vexana and Xavier. Their control effects allow Yu Zhong to land his skills more easily.

strong.desc: Yu Zhong counters squishy Fighter heroes such as Aulus and Zilong, because they can't easily dodge Yu Zhong's skills and have a hard time with him in the early game.

weak.desc: Yu Zhong is countered by nimble Marksman heroes such as Lesley and Karrie, since it's hard for Yu Zhong to land his skills, making him a vulnerable and easy target.

data.name: Popol and Kupa
data.story: Boy and an Icefield Wolf, partners who understand each other well.

assist.desc: Popol and Kupa are best with Fighters that can charge into enemies' midst and ensure the survival of Popol and Kupa after controlling and killing enemies. For example, Alpha and Khaleed.

strong.desc: Kupa is powerful in combat, especially against Marksmen with lower sustainability such as Lesley and Brody.

weak.desc:
But since Popol and Kupa don't have any Blink skills
and Popol is quite squishy, they are at the mercy of more agile Assassins like Gusion and Karina.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Atlas generates <font color="a6aafb">Frigid Breath</font> around him for 5s each time he casts a skill. Enemies affected by <font color="a6aafb">Frigid Breath</font> will have their Movement Speed gradually reduced over 2s, after which they'll be frozen for 0.5s.

Atlas gains 20<font color="26e407"> (+0.5% Extra Max HP)</font> extra Physical & Magic Defense when <font color="a6aafb">Frigid Breath</font> is present.

Atlas smashes the ground and causes 3 explosions, dealing 400<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies.

<font color="a6aafb">Ejected State</font>: If Atlas is ejected from his Mecha Sentry, both he and his Mecha will cast Annihilate.

Atlas enters <font color="a6aafb">Ejected State</font>, gaining 40% Movement Speed and immunity to Slowing Effects. In this state, the Mecha Sentry will follow the pilot at an increasing speed (can only be controlled by Suppression). Once they meet, Atlas will return to the Mecha, dealing 320<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies nearby and stunning them for 0.8s.
<font color="a6aafb">Ejected State</font>: Atlas and his Mecha share the same HP bar and reduce 50% of the damage taken in this state.

Atlas hurls chains around and starts to channel (can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 225<font color="62f8fe"> (+75% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemy heroes hit and slowing them by 40% for 3s.
Use this skill again while channeling: Atlas will drag the targets toward him and plunk them down on the designated location, dealing 360<font color="62f8fe"> (+180% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.
Use this skill in <font color="a6aafb">Ejected State</font>: The Mecha Sentry will return to Atlas immediately, but the stun effect will be replaced by 40% Slowing Effect.

data.name: Atlas
data.story: Abysmal Sea creature who broke free from the seal.

assist.desc: Atlas works well with heroes with high AOE damage like Vale and Ixia because Atlas can pull enemies together and keep them CC'd.

strong.desc: Atlas counters squishy heroes without mobility skills like Vexana and Eudora because they cannot reliably escape his CC.

weak.desc: Atlas is countered by heroes who can knock him away, such as Valir and Moskov, since they can easily stop his 2nd Skill which Atlas relies on to land his other skills.

skilllist.skilldesc: Each time Carmilla deals damage to an enemy hero, she steals 7-11 Physical & Magic Defense (scales with level) from them. The stolen Physical & Magic Defense can stack up to 5 times and lasts 5s. However, Carmilla can only steal defense from the same enemy hero once every 3s.

Carmilla summons three Crimson Flowers that circle around her for 5s, dealing 65<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> each time they hit an enemy and slowing them by 6% for 0.8s (the slow effect stacks up to 30%).

Carmilla recovers 45<font color="62f8fe"> (+21% Total Magic Power)</font> HP each time a Crimson Flower deals damage (only recovers 30% of that amount when hitting minions).

Carmilla accumulates Bloodbath Energy, gaining 70% Movement Speed that decays over 4.5s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Carmilla unleashes the accumulated Bloodbath Energy on the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and stunning them for 0.6s. The damage and stun duration scale with the accumulation time (up to 100%).

Carmilla casts Curse of Blood on the target location, slowing enemies hit by 50%. After 0.8s, enemies still within the area will take 450<font color="62f8fe"> (+130% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, and will be immobilized for 1s, slowed by 30% and linked for 5s.

When a linked enemy takes damage or becomes controlled, all the other linked targets take 50% of the damage and become controlled for 100% of the duration. Enemies can move away from one another to break the link.

data.name: Carmilla
data.story: The girl who became a Blood Demon for love.

assist.desc: Carmilla is best paired with sustained damage Mages with CC abilities like Cecilion and Aurora, as her Ultimate can greatly amplify their strengths.

strong.desc: Carmilla counters melee Fighters with low durability, such as Dyrroth and Lapu-Lapu, because she can rapidly steal their Defenses with her 1st Skill and Passive while healing herself.

weak.desc: Carmilla is countered by heroes that can ignore or remove her CC, such as Hanabi and Wanwan, since they can't be locked down by Carmilla's 2nd Skill or Ultimate.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Cecilion gains 10 extra Max Mana and recovers 10 Mana each time his skill hits an enemy. Cooldown: 1s.

Cecilion has higher Max Mana and Mana Regen, and his skill damage scales with his Max Mana.

Cecilion commands a giant bat to dive at the target location, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 1s, dealing 85<font color="62f8fe"> (+70% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="a6aafb">(+7% Total Mana)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in its path. The bat also deals 170<font color="62f8fe"> (+140% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="a6aafb">(+14% Total Mana)</font> extra <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to those near the landing point, and applies <font color="a6aafb">Overflowing</font> effect once.

Each subsequent cast within 6s increases this skill's Mana cost by 1.5 times (up to 4 stacks).

Cecilion summons a pair of opposing claws at the target location that will clasp together after a short delay, pulling enemies in their paths to the center while dealing them 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="a6aafb">(+1.2% Total Mana)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and immobilizing them for 1s.

Cecilion unleashes his Blood Demon power, gaining 60% extra Movement Speed (decays over the duration) and Slow Immunity for 1.5s. Meanwhile, he fires 36 bolts of blood energy at nearby enemies, each dealing 35<font color="62f8fe"> (+8% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="a6aafb">(+0.3% Total Mana)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the enemy hit and slowing them by 3% (up to 30%) for 1s.

Each bolt also restores 10 plus 1% of Cecilion's lost HP for him on hit.

When Carmilla is nearby, Cecilion can summon her to become a Vermil Shadow around him, granting him a 520-800 shield (scales with Carmilla's level).
Carmilla can choose to leave Cecilion and charge at the target location, gaining an equal shield while dealing 520-800 <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (scales with level) to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s.

data.name: Cecilion
data.story: Carmilla's Blood Demon lover.

assist.desc: Cecilion works well with Tanks with sustained CC abilities, such as Carmilla and Minotaur, since their CC can help Cecilion land his skills.

strong.desc: Cecilion counters less mobile Fighters like Balmond and Terizla because these heroes have a hard time getting close to Cecilion while Cecilion can more easily hit them with his skills.

weak.desc: Cecilion is countered by Assassins who can quickly close the gap like Ling and Fanny because Cecilion lacks defensive tools and his normal skills cannot hit enemies in melee range.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Silvanna's Basic Attacks deal 25<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+75% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.
Silvanna's attacks apply a mark on enemy heroes for 5s on hit, each mark reducing their Physical & Magic Defense by 3-6 (up to 5 stacks).
Silvanna's skills and Basic Attacks deal 30% extra damage to enemy heroes with the max number of marks.

Silvanna dashes forward. Upon reaching the max range or hitting a non-Minion enemy, she swings her lance, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and stunning them for 1s.

Silvanna thrusts her lance in the target direction and spins it 6 times while gaining a 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> shield. Each spin deals 165<font color="62f8fe"> (+45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slightly pulls targets toward the center. Silvanna spins 1 additional time for every 50% of extra Attack Speed she possesses.

The skill deals only 50% damage against Minions.

<font color="a6aafb">Spiral Strangling</font> counts as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.

Silvanna leaps to the target location and creates a Circle of Light upon landing, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+110% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in the area, slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, and restraining the closest enemy hero to the area for 3.5s. (This skill cannot be interrupted.)

Silvanna gains 100% Attack Speed and 40% Lifesteal when in the Circle.

data.name: Silvanna
data.story: Princess of the Moniyan Empire and queen regent.

assist.desc:
Pairing Silvanna with Tanks gives her sufficient space to dish out damage.
For example, Atlas and Tigreal.

strong.desc: Silvanna has a long attack range and powerful crowd control abilities,which makes her stronger against back-row Mages and Marksmen,such as Layla and Valir.

weak.desc:
But she can be weak against Fighters with multiple CCs
like Martis because they can easily interrupt her 2nd Skill.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Enemy heroes hit by Wanwan's attacks will have their weaknesses and positions exposed for 5s. When hitting an enemy's weakness, Wanwan deals 67(+3*Hero Level) extra <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> and increases their damage taken from her subsequent attacks by 10% for 5s.
Wanwan can dash a short distance after each arrow fired from her Basic Attack. The dash speed scales with her Attack Speed.

Wanwan throws a Fire Swallow in the target direction, triggering <font color="a6aafb">Tiger Pace</font> while dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path. The Fire Swallow then turns into 3 rotating Swallow Daggers. After a short delay, these Swallow Daggers will fly back to Wanwan one after another, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies on their way back and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. Enemies hit twice by the Swallow Daggers will be immobilized for 0.5s.

Wanwan removes all control effects on herself and triggers <font color="a6aafb">Tiger Pace</font>. Meanwhile, she shoots Deadly Needles in all directions, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit.

Wanwan leaps into the air and becomes untargetable, firing arrows at the target enemy hero for 2.5s in rapid succession, dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+35% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> per arrow. If the target is killed during this attack, Wanwan will switch to another enemy hero in her attack range, gain 30% Attack Speed, and extend the skill duration by 1s (this effect can trigger up to 3 times). Wanwan can trigger <font color="a6aafb">Tiger Pace</font> upon killing an enemy and at the end of the duration.
<font color="a6aafb">Crossbow of Tang</font> can only be cast on enemy heroes with all their weaknesses hit and Wanwan gains 100% Movement Speed during the duration. This damage is regarded as Basic Attack damage, and the firing rate scales with Wanwan's Attack Speed.

data.name: Wanwan
data.story: The Agile Tiger of the Oriental Fighters and a lively young girl who wields the Crossbow of Tang.

assist.desc: She's best with Supporting Tanks with powerful crowd control, like Franco and Belerick. They can help Wanwan hit more Weaknesses and unlock her Ultimate.

strong.desc: Wanwan is exceptional in dashing and powerful against heroes with short ranges or heavy weight, such as Fredrinn and Luo Yi.

weak.desc: However, due to her lack of durability and short attack range, Mages with longer ranges like Gord can poke her easily. She also lacks survival abilities when taking Burst damage and can be weak against Burst Assassins like Lancelot.

skilllist.skilldesc: Blessed by the Bear King, Masha has 3 HP bars and won't die until all of them are depleted. She can ignore an instance of damage and remove all Control effects on herself each time she loses an HP bar. When Masha only has two HP bars left, skills will only require 50% of their original HP Cost to cast. When Masha only has one HP bar left, she doesn't need to spend HP to cast skills.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Masha gains <font color="a6aafb">Power of the Wild</font>, causing her Basic Attacks to deal extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 2<font color="fba51f"> (+1% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of the target's Max HP (up to 60 against creeps; does not affect Turrets or the Base).
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Masha consumes 24% HP to empower herself, gaining 50% Movement Speed for 2s (this bonus decays over time). She also increases the extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> from <font color="a6aafb">Power of the Wild</font> by 3<font color="fba51f"> (+1% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of the target's Max HP and gains 50% Attack Speed for her next 2 Basic Attacks.

Masha spends 24% HP to roar at enemies, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and reducing their Attack Speed by 50% for 2s.

Masha spends 34% HP to lunge at an enemy hero (immune to control effects during the lunge), dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+220% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, slowing them by 25% for 2s, and knocking back nearby enemies. The cooldown of this skill will be reset each time Masha loses an HP bar.

Masha gains Energy when dealing damage to enemies and extra Energy when dealing damage with Wild Power.

After leaving combat for 3s, Masha can activate this skill to spend half a full bar of Energy to recover a full HP bar. Masha is invincible while casting this skill.

data.name: Masha
data.story: Guardian of the Direbears.

assist.desc: Masha can maximize her effectiveness and damage when paired with utility Supports that provide extra Movement Speed and CC, such as Angela and Rafaela.

strong.desc: Masha works well against Marksmen with low mobility, such as Ixia and Layla, as she can easily chase them down using her Ultimate.

weak.desc: Masha is countered by Fighters with strong Regen capabilities like Cici and Thamuz, because they can outlast Masha in a prolonged fight due to her comparatively lower Regen.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Baxia activates the "Baxia Mark" permanently, reducing the final damage received by 15(+1*Hero Level).
At the same time, Baxia will reduce the Shield and HP Regen of enemies hit by his skills by 40% for 4s.

Baxia retracts himself into his shield and accelerates forward. When hitting an enemy unit, he will deal 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to it and nearby enemies, stunning the target for 0.8s and slightly knocking nearby enemies back.
During the process of accelerating forward, use this skill again to launch Baxia upward so that he can cross obstacles and enemy minions. When leaping up, if there is an enemy hero under Baxia, he will strike this hero, dealing 375<font color="62f8fe"> (+75% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to this hero and nearby enemies, stunning the target hit for 1.5s, and slightly knocking other nearby enemy targets back.

Baxia throws out his shield, dealing <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 140<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 6% of the target's Max HP to the enemies along the way, marking them for 5s, and slowing them by 50% for 1s. The shield disappears upon hitting the first enemy hero or creep.
Baxia can cast the skill again in a short while. If an enemy hero or creep is hit by the skill, the skill's cooldown will be reduced to 15%.

Baxia holds his shield to the front and begins sprinting frantically, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 10s while leaving a lava path behind. Enemies on the path will take 40<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and be slowed by 15% for 0.5s every 0.5s.
For the duration, the Damage Reduction effect from <font color="a6aafb">Baxia Mark</font> is increased to 200%.

data.name: Baxia
data.story: The Mystic Tortoise of the Oriental Fighters, a shield-wielding, unstoppable wheel of flames.

assist.desc: Baxia can utilize his AOE damage and slow effect to help sustained damage heroes like Thamuz and Alpha stay on their targets.

strong.desc: Baxia counters heroes with multi-hit skills or those who rely on shields or HP Regen, such as Chang'e and Silvanna, thanks to his Passive.

weak.desc: Baxia is countered by agile Marksmen who deal True Damage like Karrie and Lesley because they can easily stay out of Baxia's range while dealing massive damage to him.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_706573f138055c3df3df94948b4f26bd.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Lylia gains power from <font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font>, increasing her Movement Speed by 15%. Each <font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font> upgrade further increases this bonus by 5%.
<font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font> gains an upgrade each time he devours <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font>, up to 5 times. Higher levels increase the detonation damage of <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font>.

Lylia sends out <font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font> with a shockwave, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in a line and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s.
If <font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font> touches <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font>, he will devour and detonate it.

Lylia condenses <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font> at the target area, dealing 90<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and briefly slowing them by 80%.
<font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font> detonates when devoured by <font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font>, dealing 220<font color="62f8fe"> (+115% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies. Each <font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font> upgrade increases the detonation damage by 20% (up to 80%).
<font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font> restores 20% of <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font>'s recharge time upon hitting an enemy hero.
Lylia starts with the <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font> skill, storing one charge every 6s.

Lylia immediately returns to the Black Shoes' location from 4s ago, restoring her HP and Mana to their previous states and recovering an extra 10% Max HP.
She also gains 20% extra Movement Speed for 2s.

data.name: Lylia
data.story: A funny and witted little witch.

assist.desc: Lylia excels in prolonged battles, and works well with heroes with strong CC, like Franco and Minotaur.

strong.desc: Lylia counters Tank heroes without Blink skills, such as Carmilla and Hylos, who cannot easily escape Gloom's AOE range and are more susceptible to Lylia's high sustained damage.

weak.desc: Since most of Lylia's damage comes from detonating her 2nd Skill, but setting up Gloom can be quite slow, nimble Assassins like Nolan and Ling counter Lylia as she'll have a tough time hitting them.

skilllist.skilldesc:
When Dyrroth's Rage reaches 50%, he enhances <font color="a6aafb">Burst Strike</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Spectre Step</font>.

After every 2 Basic Attacks, Dyrroth releases a Circle Strike, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> - <font color="fba51f"> (+180% Total Physical Attack)</font> (scales with level) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the circle and recovering <font color="26e407"> 7%</font> - <font color="26e407"> 10%</font> <font color="26e407">Max HP</font> (scales with level, halved against minions). This strike does not trigger Attack Effect.
Each time he damages an enemy, the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Burst Strike</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Spectre Step</font> is reduced by 1s.

Dyrroth recovers 2% - 5% Rage per second (scales with level).

Dyrroth releases a burst strike in a designated direction. Each burst deals 240<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies and slows them by 25% for 1.5s. (The damage decays against the same target and decreases to only 75% on minions.)

<font color="a6aafb">Abyss Enhanced</font>: Burst Strike has a longer range, deals 140% of the original damage, and its Slowing Effect is doubled.

Dyrroth dashes in the designated direction. He will stop when he has traveled the max distance or hits one enemy hero or a Creep, dealing 230<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and slightly knocking them back. When he uses this skill again, he will lock onto a target and release a Fatal Strike, dealing 345<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and reducing the target's Physical Defense by 40% for 4s.
<font color="a6aafb">Abyss Enhanced</font>: Fatal Strike will reach further and deal 150% of the original damage, slow the target by an extra 90% and reduce the target's Physical Defense by 60% for 4s.

After a short delay, Dyrroth launches a destructive strike in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 650<font color="fba51f"> (+250% Extra Physical Attack)</font> plus 20% of the target's lost HP as <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path, and slowing them by 55% for 0.8s. This skill deals up to 1500 damage to non-hero enemies.

data.name: Dyrroth
data.story: Once a noble prince of the Moniyan Empire, he was abducted by Alice, the Queen of the Blood Demons, and transformed into the Prince of the Abyss.

assist.desc: Dyrroth's high melee burst damage works best with heroes with single-target CC, such as Franco and Kaja.

strong.desc: Dyrroth has good chasing abilities and good melee burst damage, he is strong against heroes with poor Mobility, such as Gord and Hanabi.

weak.desc: Being a melee hero makes Dyrroth weak against heroes with Slow and kiting abilities, such as Vexana and Belerick.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Ling's superb Lightness Skill allows him to leap among walls. He gains 4 extra Lightness Points per second when he's on a wall and 5 extra Lightness Points each time he deals damage.

Ling gains 1.6 times Crit Chance from all sources but only has 140% Crit Damage.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Ling's Crit Chance is increased by 2.5%.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Ling leaps onto the designated wall and enters the <font color="a6aafb">Half-Stealth</font> state, restoring Lightness Points faster and gaining 30% Movement Speed. Taking damage causes him to leave <font color="a6aafb">Half-Stealth</font>. Being controlled makes him fall to the ground and slows him by 30% for 2s. When he uses this skill to jump from one wall to another, it does not trigger cooldown and refreshes <font color="a6aafb">Half-Stealth</font>.

Ling charges in the target direction and stabs nearby enemies, dealing them 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.
If Ling casts this skill when he's on the wall (no energy cost), he'll dash to the target location on the ground, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. 
<font color="a6aafb">Defiant Sword</font> is regarded as Basic Attack.

Ling leaps into the air, becoming invincible and gaining 10% extra Movement Speed for 1.5s. He ignores obstacles when in the air. He then lands on the ground, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, knocking those in the center airborne for 1s, and creating a Sword Field for 8s.

Four <font color="a6aafb">Tempest of Blades</font> will also appear on the edge of the Sword Field. Ling can touch them to reduce the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Finch Poise</font> by 4s, reset the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Defiant Sword</font>, and gain 25 Lightness Points.

data.name: Ling
data.story: A graceful, free-soaring Finch and the Oriental Fighter who inherited the Vermilion Bird's power.

assist.desc: Ling works best with support heroes with CC abilities, that make Ling more flexible in different situations. Such as Angela and Khufra.

strong.desc: Ling's excellent pursuit abilities and high burst damage make him strong against squishy heroes, like Layla and Hanabi.

weak.desc: Ling is countered by heroes with strong single-target CC and high burst damage, as they can easily control Ling and burst him down. Such as Eudora and Jawhead.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Firaga Armor inherits 160% of X.Borg's Max HP and absorbs all incoming damage when it's active. When destroyed, X.Borg rolls in the direction of the Joystick (he is invincible during this process). The Armor's energy will gradually regenerate while X.Borg is in the Armorless State. At full energy, X.Borg re-equips the Armor and restores it to 30% HP.
X.Borg's attacks cause enemies to enter <font color="a6aafb">Overheated</font> state. Enemies in <font color="a6aafb">Overheated</font> state will drop Firaga Supplies when they take damage from X.Borg. Picking up supplies restores 10% of the Armor's HP (or 10 energy while in the Armorless State).
X.Borg's skills deal <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> to enemies in <font color="a6aafb">Overheated</font> state.

X.Borg sprays fire, dealing 25<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 7 times over 2s to enemies in front of him (75% damage to minions). 

Armorless State: The attack area becomes narrower but longer, while the damage is reduced to 60%.

X.Borg fires 5 Fire Stakes forward and recalls them after 1.7s. Each stake deals 50<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and pulls enemies and Firaga Supplies along its path back to him.

Armorless State: X.Borg adjusts the Fire Stake launcher, making the stakes travel farther and closer together.

X.Borg charges in the target direction while spinning and spraying fire (cannot pick up Firaga Supplies during this time), dealing 90<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 12 times and slowing enemies hit by 25%. He stops upon touching an enemy hero and will slow them by an additional 40%. After 3s, his mecha suit detonates, dealing 300 plus 15% of the target's Max HP as <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font>. If his armor is destroyed, it will immediately explode but damage drops to 50%. The detonation destroys his Armor, removes all debuffs, and collects all nearby Firaga Supplies. Cannot be used in <font color="a6aafb">Armorless State</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Immediately stop spraying fire and detonate early.

data.name: X.Borg
data.story: An uncontrollable flame that's determined to take revenge against Eruditio.

assist.desc: X.Borg pairs well with heroes who excel in burst damage, such as Karina and Martis. X.Borg's AOE damage will leave enemies low enough for his teammate to finishing off.

strong.desc: X.Borg counters Fighters that lack mobility, such as Terizla and Aulus. His 1st Skill has a large range and can be cast while moving, making it easy for him to kite.

weak.desc: X.Borg is countered by Fighters with burst damage like Martis and Dyrroth. They can quickly burst down X.Borg when he is Armorless.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Terizla gains 1% extra Damage Reduction (up to 20 (+1*Hero Level)%) for every 2.5% HP lost.
He cannot gain extra Attack Speed and will convert every 1% extra Attack Speed he's supposed to receive into 1 extra Physical Attack.

Terizla cracks the ground with his hammer and the fissure will spread out, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. After the fissure hits the first target, it will drill into the target and slow them by 15%. At the same time, Terizla's Movement Speed will be increased by 15% for 3.5s. The fissure on target will then explode, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> plus 20% of the enemy's lost HP <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

Terizla swings his hammer in a fan-shaped area ahead. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The first two attacks deal 90<font color="fba51f"> (+135% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each, while the third deals 225<font color="fba51f"> (+220% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 20% for 1.25s (the Slowing Effect can stack).
Deals only 80% damage to Minions.

Terizla jumps to the designated area, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s. He then summons Scaffold and slows enemies by 25%. Scaffold will send out a hook at enemy heroes in range and pull them several times while dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each time.

data.name: Terizla
data.story: Once an eccentric master smith, but now an avenger siding with the Abyss.

assist.desc: Terizla works best with heroes who have strong initiation skills that allow him to deal more damage with his skills, heroes like Gatotkaca and Atlas are good examples here.

strong.desc: Terizla is strong against light melee fighters cause they'll have a hard time surviving his heavy skill damage, such as Zilong and Sun.

weak.desc: Terizla is countered by heroes with good Mobility or long attack range, because it will be diffcult to hit them with his skills. Such as Arlott and Lesley.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Esmeralda manipulates Stardust and Frostmoon: Stardust deals Physical Damage while Frostmoon deals Magic Damage and gives the target a shield equal to 135% of Frostmoon's damage dealt. Each Basic Attack deals <font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+75% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.
The damage dealt by Esmeralda ignores all shield effects and gradually converts her shield into HP.

Esmeralda gains 400<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> Shield and 40% Movement Speed which rapidly decays over its duration for 4s. Meanwhile, she gradually transforms the shields of her nearby enemies into her own shield, capped at 50% of her Max HP.

Esmeralda waves Stardust and Frostmoon, dealing 240<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies. Each time she deals damage to a hero, the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Frostmoon Shield</font> is reduced by 1.5s (damaging non-hero units grants a 0.5s reduction) and the enemy's Movement Speed is reduced by 10% for 1.5s.

Esmeralda coheres the power of Astrospace into her two weapons - Stardust and Frostmoon. The longer this skill is channeled, the longer the cast range.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Esmeralda casts Stardust at the target location, dealing 350<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, and then blinks to the target location and casts Frostmoon, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+140% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and immobilizing enemies in the area for 1s.

data.name: Esmeralda
data.story: A mysterious astrologer.

assist.desc: Esmeralda works best with heroes that can pull enemies together like Atlas and Tigreal to allow her to hit more targets with her Ultimate.

strong.desc: Esmeralda works well against heroes with shields, like Akai and Lolita, because her skills not only ignore their shields, but she also converts them into her own.

weak.desc: Esmeralda is countered by highly mobile Marksmen, such as Karrie and Lesley, because she lacks the burst damage to finish them off quickly and can't keep up with their mobility.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_901bdd5d4432a2c0290dfc71df615a5a.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Guinevere deals 25% extra damage to airborne enemies and deals <font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> with her Basic Attacks. 
Guinevere builds Super Magic each time she deals damage. Once fully charged, her next Basic Attack becomes guided, dealing 80<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+90% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic damage</font> on hit and restoring <font color="26e407">80 plus 8% of her lost HP</font>.
Enemies hit by Guinevere's skills or enhanced Basic Attack will be marked for 5s. Those with 3 marks will be knocked airborne when hit by her Violet Requiem.

Guinevere releases an energy orb in the target direction, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+125% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing enemies by 25% for 1.2s.
Successfully hitting an enemy reduces all her skill cooldowns by 1s.

Guinevere leaps to the target location, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. Enemy heroes and Creeps hit will be knocked airborne for 1s and take 125<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> additional <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.
<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Guinevere blinks toward the target direction and leaves an illusion behind. If the illusion takes damage by hero, it restores Super Magic for Guinevere and explodes after 1.5s, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

Guinevere creates a force field around her, gaining Control Immunity while attacking nearby enemies 11 times within 2s, dealing 880<font color="62f8fe"> (+385% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> in total.
Airborne enemies hit will be knocked airborne again, up to 8 additional times.

data.name: Guinevere
data.story: Aristocratic girl with a strange temperament, loved by her elder brother Lancelot.

assist.desc: Guinevere works best with heroes with good single-target CC that will give her a better environment to farm and deal damage, such as Franco and Hylos.

strong.desc: Guinevere is strong against heroes with poor sustainability or who are simply weak in the early game. This is because Guinevere can easily deliver her poking combo and escape. Heroes like Zilong and Silvanna are good examples here.

weak.desc: But Guinevere is countered by heroes with CC immunities or strong CC skills. Since she needs to chain her CC to unleash her full damage potential, such as Badang and Chou.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Granger's unique Demon Hunting <font color="a6aafb">Gun</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Cannon</font> are powered by Demonic Energy. Both his weapons start with 800 max Energy. His <font color="a6aafb">Gun</font> restores 8% Energy per second while his <font color="a6aafb">Cannon</font> restores 2% Energy per second. Killing a Minion / Creep permanently increases their max Energy by 6 / 6, and instantly restores their Energy by 5% / 5%, respectively. Each kill or assist on an enemy hero permanently increases both weapons' max Energy by 12 and instantly restores 10% Energy.

Every 1% Cooldown Reduction converts to 2 Physical Attack. Demonic Energy costs are not affected by Energy Cost Reduction.

Granger rapidly fires 6 shot(s) with his <font color="a6aafb">Gun</font>, with each shot dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and consuming 70 <font color="a6aafb">Gun</font> Energy. The last shot is guaranteed to Crit. While firing, Granger's Movement Speed is increased by 10%.

Granger stops firing when he runs out of Energy, or when the skill is cast again. <font color="a6aafb">Rhapsody</font> has no cooldown and can be cast once his <font color="a6aafb">Gun</font> Energy is over 420.

Granger uses his Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15% Energy for his <font color="a6aafb">Gun</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Rondo</font> can be cast while channeling <font color="a6aafb">Rhapsody</font>. Each time <font color="a6aafb">Rhapsody</font> hits an enemy, <font color="a6aafb">Rondo's</font> Cooldown is reduced by 0.5s.

Granger fires his <font color="a6aafb">Cannon</font> in the target direction, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+110% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hero hit and other targets in the blast radius. Targets hit will be briefly slowed. Granger can roll in the Joystick's direction after each shot.
<font color="a6aafb">Death Sonata</font> can be cast while firing <font color="a6aafb">Rhapsody</font>. <font color="a6aafb">Death Sonata</font> has a brief cooldown and consumes 250 of Granger's <font color="a6aafb">Cannon</font> Energy per shot.

data.name: Granger
data.story: A mysterious demon hunter that operates outside the conventions of the Church of Light. Always seen with a violin case in hand, he hunts down demons with his two soul-devouring weapons.

assist.desc: Granger pairs well with heroes that have strong CC abilities, such as Franco and Kaja, who can hold enemies in place for Granger's entire 1st Skill.

strong.desc: Granger counters squishy heroes who lack mobility, such as Chang'e and Cecilion, who have a hard time dodging his 1st Skill and are vulnerable to the high damage of his Ultimate.

weak.desc: Granger is countered by heroes with strong single target killing power. Despite having good mobility, Granger lacks other defensive measures. Heroes like Saber and Hayabusa can quickly get the jump on Granger and finish him off.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Khufra activates the Spell Curse left by Esmeralda every 8s, enhancing his next Basic Attack. The enhanced Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to <font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> plus 6% of the target's Max HP. He also slows the target by 30% for 1.5s and heals 8% of his Max HP on hit.
Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with his skill, the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Spell Curse</font> is reduced by 4s.

Khufra pulls the bandage on his arms to launch himself in the specified direction, dealing <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 50 plus 7<font color="fba51f"> (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of his Max HP to all enemy units on the path. When blinking to the furthest distance or encountering a first enemy hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 50 plus 7<font color="fba51f"> (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of his Max HP to enemies nearby and then knocking them in the air for up to 1s.

Khufra uses bandage to wrap himself into a magic bouncing ball, increasing his own Physical & Magic Defense by 30%. Enemies trying to use blink skills to move across Khufra will be knocked airborne. 
Each time the magic bouncing ball hits the ground, it will deal <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 50 plus 3<font color="fba51f"> (+2% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of his Max HP to enemies nearby and slow them by 80% for 0.2s.

Khufra pushes back all enemy targets around him toward his front (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing them down for 1.25s. If the enemies are knocked against walls, extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 150% of this skill's damage will be inflicted upon them, and they will be stunned, instead of slowed.

data.name: Khufra
data.story: Sealed ancient tyrant.

assist.desc: Khufra works best with heroes with strong CC abilities that make it easier for his 1st Skill to hit, such as Eudora and Pharsa.

strong.desc: Khufra's 2nd Skill can be used to interrupt movement abilities, making him strong against heroes who fight with movement abilities, such as Joy and Lancelot.

weak.desc: Khufra is countered by resilient tank heroes, as his CC abilities pose no threat to these heroes. Heroes like Fredrinn and Gloo are good examples here.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_9fb1784545a48aef42241fc7a719c575.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Every time Badang's Basic Attack hits a target, he gains a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Chivalry Fist</font>. After gaining 4 stacks, his next Basic Attack deals 50<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and knocks them back. Enemies that are knocked into obstacles will be stunned for 0.6s (Minions and Creeps are stunned directly).
<font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> generated by Badang's skills will trigger this effect directly, and <font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> from his Ultimate increases the stun duration to 1s.

Badang unleashes a gust of <font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> in the target direction, dealing 125<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit, slowing them by 30% for 1.5s, and knocking them back. The <font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies. <font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> can trigger attack effects and grants Badang 1 <font color="a6aafb">Chivalry Fist</font> stack upon cast.
Badang stores up to 2 <font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> charges and restores 1 charge every 10.4s.

Badang dashes in the target direction, dealing 230<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in his path while gaining a 350<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> shield that lasts 5s. He stops immediately upon hitting an enemy hero, slightly knocking them back while creating an obstacle that lasts 4s behind them. Enemies hit by the obstacle are dealt 130<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Badang removes the obstacle he created.

Badang throws a flurry of punches in the target direction, dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+54% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit multiple times (can trigger attack effects). The <font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> generated by the punches will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 30<font color="fba51f"> (+27% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.
Badang is immune to control effects for the duration.

data.name: Badang
data.story: Island hero who gained supernatural power after defeating the water monster.

assist.desc: Badang works best with heroes that can pull enemies together to make it easier for him to land his 2nd Skill and Ultimate combo, such as Tigreal and Luo Yi.

strong.desc: Badang counters squishy heroes with low mobility like Layla and Odette who have a hard time escaping from his 2nd Skill into Ultimate combo.

weak.desc: Badang is countered by agile heroes such as Wanwan and Ling who can dodge or escape his 2nd Skill, greatly diminishing his damage and CC.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_04e575d648d7f7ac1174f4369595c3a2.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Every 4s, Faramis' next skill against enemy heroes and summoned objects generates a soul fragment on the spot. Faramis can absorb the soul fragment to restore 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> HP and gain 2 extra Magic Power (up to 40 stacks). Upon death, he consumes the absorbed soul fragments to reduce the respawn timer, each reducing the timer by 3% (up to 90%). Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance to drop soul fragments.

Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3s, gaining 70% Movement Speed, 25 Physical & Magic Defense, and 20% Cooldown Reduction of this skill. He also gains the ability to move through terrain. Enemy heroes he touches take 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and are marked with a <font color="a6aafb">Nether Mark</font>. Upon leaving the Shadow state, Faramis pulls all the marked enemy heroes toward him, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. 
<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Ends the Shadow state early to pull marked enemy heroes toward him.
Soul Fragment absorption range is increased while this skill is active.

Faramis gathers Nether energy in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing 330<font color="62f8fe"> (+144% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce to nearby enemies, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+86% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (splits up to 2 time(s) on enemy hero hits and 1 time(s) on non-enemy hero hits).

Faramis turns his surroundings into the <font color="a6aafb">Nether Realm</font> for 6s. Allied heroes within (including himself) enter the <font color="a6aafb">Specter</font> state, gaining 400 (+ 10<font color="62f8fe"> (+5% Total Magic Power)</font>%) extra HP and 50% extra Movement Speed for 1s. When the <font color="a6aafb">Specter</font> state breaks, heroes within clear all debuffs and enter a brief Resurrection state for 1.3s. The <font color="a6aafb">Specter</font> state immediately ends if the allied hero leaves the <font color="a6aafb">Nether Realm</font>.

data.name: Faramis
data.story: A necromancer in Necrokeep who's determined to find a cure for the Mist.

assist.desc: Faramis works well with heroes that are designed to dive into the enemy, such as Leomord and Martis, as he'll be able to maximize the life-saving effect of his Ultimate.

strong.desc: Faramis' ability to temporarily prevent teammates from being killed makes him a good pick against heroes that go all-in to burst down a target, like Saber and Eudora.

weak.desc: Faramis is countered by high mobility heroes that are difficult for him to catch with his 1st Skill, such as Novaria and Pharsa.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Kadita gains the <font color="a6aafb">Blessing of the Ocean</font> every 30s. Taking damage from an enemy hero triggers the Blessing for 4s.

When the duration ends, she recovers 65% of the HP lost during this time (damage from minions and creeps does not trigger this effect).

Kadita summons an ocean wave to carry herself in the target direction and back, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+90% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. While inside the wave, she gains Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction. This skill can pass through obstacles and terrain.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Kadita exits the wave without interrupting the wave's movement.

After a short delay, Kadita summons an ocean wave to erupt at the target location, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+140% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1s.

Kadita can cast this skill during <font color="a6aafb">Ocean Ode</font> to summon an ocean wave beneath her with a shorter eruption delay.

Kadita dives into the ground and sends ocean waves in all directions (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), each dealing 270<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit by multiple waves take increased damage. After a short period, the waves return to Kadita, each dealing 180<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit.

When underground, Kadita becomes untargetable and gains 60% Movement Speed.

data.name: Kadita
data.story: Beautiful and powerful mermaid queen.

assist.desc: Kadita works well with heroes who possess strong CC abilities, such as Atlas and Tigreal, as their CC will make it easier for Kadita to hit more enemies with her Ultimate.

strong.desc: Kadita excels at countering heroes that lack mobility, such as Aurora and Eudora, because it's difficult for them to escape Kadita's 2nd Skill, and knocking them airborne sets them up for her Ultimate.

weak.desc: Kadita is countered by heroes with long range and high mobility, such as Clint and Beatrix, since it's difficult for Kadita to close in on them or hit them with her 2nd Skill.

skilllist.skilldesc: Minsitthar's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Mark of the King</font>, up to 5 stacks. Can only trigger once every 6s on the same target.

Minsitthar thrusts forward with the Spear of Glory, dealing 175<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing enemies hit by 30%. Enemy heroes hit by the tip of the spear will be stunned for 0.6s. After a short delay, Minsitthar pulls back the spear, dealing 175<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to all enemies along the way and dragging enemy heroes hit to him.

Minsitthar awakens the power in his shield and releases it, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to all enemies in a rectangular area and slowing them by 80% (decaying rapidly over 2s). Meanwhile, he enters <font color="a6aafb">Phalanx</font> state for 3s, reducing damage taken from the front by 25% and enhancing his Basic Attack to swiftly strike an area in front of him for 100<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> per hit.

Minsitthar charges forward and calls 4 Royal Guards to form a field around him. The Royal Guards cannot move but will attack enemies in the field and deal <font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to them.
Enemies in the field are slowed by 30% and cannot use movement skills.

data.name: Minsitthar
data.story: A young king that led the people of Mahar Pura to victory against invaders.

assist.desc: Minsitthar works best with high damage Marksmen, such as Melissa and Hanabi, because he can create more opportunities for them to deal damage.

strong.desc: Minsitthar is strong against heroes that rely on mobility skills since his Ultimate disables them. Minsitthar can instantly negate the advantages of heroes like Lancelot, Benedetta and Arlott.

weak.desc: Minsitthar is countered by heroes with high Movement Speed, such as Zilong and Aulus, who can easily dodge his 1st Skill and run out of his Ultimate.

skilllist.skilldesc: Harith gains insight from his Key. He gains 7% Hybrid Lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.

Harith creates a phantom of himself in a distant location. Harith and his phantom then release <font color="a6aafb">Synchro Fission</font> toward each other, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemy units on the path.

When the 2 energy waves collide, they explode, dealing 450<font color="62f8fe"> (+180% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies in the area.
This skill deals 60% extra damage to creeps (up to 1500 damage).

Harith dashes towards the target direction, gaining a 120<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> shield and enhancing his next Basic Attack. Harith's enhanced Basic Attack deals 200<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe">(+70% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slows enemies by 40%. When Harith comes into contact with the rift using <font color="a6aafb">Chrono Dash</font>, he absorbs its energy, reducing the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Synchro Fission</font> by 1s and <font color="a6aafb">Chrono Dash</font> by 3s. Harith gains 15% Resilience while on the rift.

data.name: Harith
data.story: Leonin boy who came to the Moniyan Empire from Azrya.

assist.desc: Harith pairs well with heroes who have AOE CC and can make it harder for enemies to escape his Ultimate's range, such as Minsitthar and Minotaur.

strong.desc: Harith is a very agile hero and his Ultimate reduces the duration of control effects, so he is excellent at countering heroes who rely on CC and have relatively long casting animations, like Belerick and Johnson.

weak.desc: Harith is countered by heroes who can quickly escape from his Ultimate, such as Novaria and Pharsa.

Thamuz's Basic Attacks have a chance of 10%–60% (scaling with <font color="a6aafb">Lava's Rage</font>) to conjure Lava Energy beneath the target that erupts after a brief delay, dealing 55<font color="ffe63c"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="ffe63c">(+8*Hero Level)</font> <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font>. Basic Attacks that don't trigger Lava Energy increase Thamuz's <font color="a6aafb">Lava's Rage</font>.

While Thamuz is without his <font color="a6aafb">Scythes</font>, he gains 25% Movement Speed. After retrieving his <font color="a6aafb">Scythes</font>, his next Basic Attack slows the target by 30% and is guaranteed to trigger Lava Energy.

Thamuz tosses <font color="a6aafb">Scythes</font> in the target direction. After traveling a set distance or hitting the first enemy hero, they deal 120<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. The <font color="a6aafb">Scythes</font> will then slow nearby enemies by 30% and deal 45<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> every 0.5s.

After leaving Thamuz for a short time or reaching a set distance, the <font color="a6aafb">Scythes</font> return to him, dragging enemies along their path toward Thamuz. Thamuz can move toward the <font color="a6aafb">Scythes</font> or cast the skill again to retrieve them.

Thamuz jumps to a designated area to deal 230<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slow the enemy units by 25% for 2s upon landing. 
If the Scythes are still travelling, they will return to Thamuz and <font color="a6aafb">Molten Scythes</font> will reset its CD instantly.

Thamuz spouts the lava within, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and creating a <font color="a6aafb">Cauterant Zone</font> around himself. The <font color="a6aafb">Cauterant Zone</font> lasts 9s and deals 30<font color="fba51f"> (+10% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> every 0.5s to enemies in the area.

Meanwhile, Thamuz gains 800<font color="26e407"> (+50% Extra Max HP)</font> extra Max HP, immediately healing for the same amount, and gains 60% Attack Speed. Each time his Basic Attacks or <font color="a6aafb">Scythes</font> deal damage, he recovers 1.5% Max HP.

data.name: Thamuz
data.story: The lord of the Fire Demons who seeks to reignite the flames of the Abyss through war and violence.

assist.desc: Thamuz can play to his strength when working with Supports who provide Movement Speed or CC, such as Angela and Rafaela, because they enable him to stay on his targets.

strong.desc: Thamuz is good against other sustained damage Fighters like Zilong and Sun because he has the top notch laning power.

weak.desc: Thamuz is countered by agile Marksmen, such as Karrie and Irithel, since he lacks CC and relies on Basic Attacks, making him an easy target to kite.

Each <font color="a6aafb">Chemical Bolt</font> deals <font color="fba51f"> (+18% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+24% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. Kimmy fires a <font color="a6aafb">Starlium Beam</font> in the target direction, immobilizing enemies in its path and dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> for 1s.

Kimmy charges and fires a <font color="a6aafb">Traction Pulse</font> in the target direction. Upon hitting an enemy or reaching its max range, it explodes to deal 150<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+54% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and creates a force field that slows enemies within by 50%.

After 1s, the field contracts, pulling all enemy heroes to its center and dealing 15% of their current HP as <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> while slowing them by 50% for 2s. Each enemy hero hit grants 40 Starlium.

data.name: Kimmy
data.story: Born into a military family, she earned recognition through her own merit as the bold yet laid-back "tough girl" of the Border Guard.

assist.desc: Kimmy excels at controlling and grouping enemies while dealing substantial damage, so she works well with heroes who have AOE CC like Badang and Ruby.

strong.desc: Kimmy's ability to Basic Attack while moving makes her effective against heroes who rely on skillshots like Granger and Cecilion.

weak.desc: As a Marksman who cannot lock onto targets with Basic Attacks, Kimmy can be countered by heroes with high burst damage and mobility, such as Saber and Lancelot.

Whenever Belerick takes 50 or more damage, he has a 25% chance to shoot the nearest enemy unit, dealing <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 55(+5*Hero Level) plus 1.8% of his Max HP (scales with level). This attack can be triggered once every 0.4s.
His HP obtained from Equipment and Emblems is increased by 30%.

Belerick conjures spreading vines around him, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in the area 4 times, taunting and slowing them for 1.5s.

data.name: Belerick
data.story: A kind and fraternal elemental creature.

assist.desc: Belerick works well with heroes who can dish out a lot of damage against enemies CC'd by his taunt, such as Miya and Natan.

strong.desc: Belerick excels at controlling enemies at close range, making him a great counter against squishy Assassins who need to get close to deal damage, like Lancelot and Ling.

weak.desc: Belerick is countered by heroes with long-range attacks like Valir and Xavier.

skilllist.skilldesc: Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attacks and skills inflicts a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Dark Ninjutsu</font> on the target, up to 5 stacks. <font color="a6aafb">Ninjutsu: Demon Feast</font> can only be cast on targets with full stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Dark Ninjutsu</font>.

The skill can only be used on targets with max stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Dark Ninjutsu</font>. When targeting a creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover 20% HP.
When targeting the Turtle, Lord, or enemy heroes, he deals 600<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, recovers 10% HP, and reduces this skill's cooldown by 60%.

Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving <font color="a6aafb">dark mist</font> in front that deals 90<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area every 0.5s, up to 5 times (this damage counts as Basic Attack damage but cannot Crit).
The <font color="a6aafb">dark mist</font> slows enemies in the area by 40% and grants Hanzo 20% Movement Speed.

Hanzo charges into battle as <font color="a6aafb">Hanekage</font>, consuming 170 Energy per second. He gains 20 Energy when a nearby non-hero unit dies and 200 Energy if it's a hero. He gains 15 Energy when attacking a hero, and 45 Energy when attacking the Turtle or the Lord. Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attacks and skills inflicts a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Dark Ninjutsu</font> on the target, up to 5 stacks. <font color="a6aafb">Ninjutsu: Demon Feast</font> can only be cast on targets with full stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Dark Ninjutsu</font>.

Hanekage dashes to an enemy hero, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and its surrounding units after a brief delay. Each stack of <font color="a6aafb">Dark Ninjutsu</font> on the target increases the damage by 20% (surrounding units are not affected by this bonus). When the target has max stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Dark Ninjutsu</font>, it deals additional damage equal to 15<font color="fba51f"> (+2% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of the target's Max HP (this damage ignores 30% of the target's Physical Defense) and recovers 20% HP for Hanzo.

Hanekage dashes in the target direction, briefly knocking enemies in his path airborne for 0.4s and leaving <font color="a6aafb">dark mist</font> in the area he passes through (recovers 200 Energy when hitting an enemy hero). The mist deals 135<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area every 0.5s, up to 5 times (this damage counts as Basic Attack damage but cannot Crit).
The <font color="a6aafb">dark mist</font> slows enemies in the area by 40%.
Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body and exits the Hanekage form.

data.name: Hanzo
data.story: Genius ninja in the Shadow Sect who is at the crossroads.

assist.desc: Hanzo has high burst potential but needs time to stack his Passive, so he works best with heroes who can keep the enemy CC'd, like Aurora, Belerick, and Tigreal.

strong.desc: Hanzo's Ultimate enables him to poke or dive with relative safety, making him a serious threat to squishy heroes without mobility, like Layla, Ixia, and Zhuxin, while also disrupting the enemy in teamfights.

weak.desc: Hanzo fares less favorably against heroes with lots of mobility, such as Fanny, Lancelot, and Arlott, since it's difficult to build stacks on them, thus limiting Hanzo's damage.

data.name: Lunox

weak.desc: Lunox is countered by heroes with high mobility since her 2nd Skill has limited range and she lacks CC. Nimble heroes like Nolan and Ling can get in and out of her range all too easily.

data.name: Aldous

data.name: Selena

data.name: Chang'e

data.name: Martis

assist.desc: Martis works best with Fighters that initiate teamfights like Alpha and Khaleed who he can follow up to secure a kill and chain more kills with his Ultimate.

weak.desc: Martis is countered by Fighters with high combat sustainability, such as Thamuz and Fredrinn, because they can survive Martis' burst damage and defeat him in prolonged battles.

data.name: Valir
data.story: Heir to Fire Throat, fire mage.

assist.desc: Teaming up with Fighters with strong initiation like Khaleed and Yu Zhong can simultaneously enhance the entire team's combat potential.

data.name: Gusion

data.name: Angela

data.name: Lesley
data.story: Adopted daughter of House Vance, a clandestine sniper.

assist.desc: Lesley works best with tank heroes who can provide better attacking conditions for her, like Minotaur and Baxia.

data.name: Pharsa

data.name: Helcurt
data.story: The nightmare of the Abyss who's willing to betray anyone in order to survive.

data.name: Zhask

data.name: Lancelot
data.story: Prodigal son and genius swordsman of House Baroque.

assist.desc: Lancelot works well with heroes who can pull enemies together, like Atlas and Tigreal, because they allow him to hit more enemies with his AOE skills.

strong.desc: Lancelot counters long-range Mages, such as Cecilion and Pharsa, because there is a delay to their skills and Lancelot can use his 1st Skill to dodge them while going in for the kill.

weak.desc: Lancelot is weak against heroes who can counter his mobility like Minsitthar and Phoveus, as his 1st Skill and Ultimate will be heavily restricted.

skilllist.skilldesc:
For 8s after casting a skill, Odette's next Basic Attack gains extra range and bounces between enemies (or an enemy and herself), dealing 144-200<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> per hit.

Odette's skills also trigger this effect on hit (up to 3 stacks).

Odette releases a magic swan in the target direction, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

Odette releases magic energy balls in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.5s. Upon hit, an energy ball splits off to attack a nearby enemy (prioritizes enemy heroes), dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and immobilizing them for 1.5s.

Odette begins to dance, gaining a 1200<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> shield while dealing up to 2000<font color="62f8fe"> (+750% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in a large area around her for 5s. The bounce speed and frequency of <font color="a6aafb">Lakeshore Ambience</font>'s sound wave in the area are also enhanced when the skill is active.
Use again while the skill is active to dash in the target direction.
<font color="A4AAC7">The skill is a channeling cast and will be interrupted if Odette is hit by high level control effects (knocked airborne, transformed, etc.) or if she performs another action.</font>

data.name: Odette
data.story: Innocent princess that grew up in the Swan Castle and genius mage that excels in sword and scepter.

assist.desc: Pair Odette with heroes who can relocate their teammates like Johnson and Jawhead to make it easier for her to find the perfect position for her Ultimate.

strong.desc: Odette's Ultimate is capable of unleashing massive damage and is effective against heroes lacking interruption skills, such as Layla and Irithel.

weak.desc: Odette is countered by heroes with Crowd Control skills, such as Minotaur and Edith, because they can easily interrupt her Ultimate.

skilllist.skilldesc:
When Argus' Meteoric Sword reaches 100 <font color="a6aafb">Malice Energy</font>, he will launch a <font color="a6aafb">Demonic Slash</font> with his next Basic Attack, dealing 180<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and recovering 150<font color="fba51f"> (+10% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP. This attack ignores 40% of the target's Physical Defense.
Argus' Meteoric Sword gains 5 <font color="a6aafb">Malice Energy</font> per second and 10 Energy per Basic Attack (critical strikes grant an additional 10 Energy).

Argus stretches out a demonic hand in the target direction, dealing 125<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hero or Creep hit, stunning them for 0.7s, and pulling him and the target towards each other. If no enemy is hit, Argus pulls himself toward the hand's destination instead.
<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Argus dashes and strikes in the target direction, dealing 175<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the path.

After a short delay, Argus thrusts his Meteoric Sword in the target direction, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit (200% damage against minions) and reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 0.8s. The delay time decreases as Argus's Attack Speed increases. Enemy heroes hit will be <font color="a6aafb">Cursed</font> for 4s, during which they leave a Cursed Trail behind. Argus gains 20% Movement Speed while on a Cursed Trail.
<font color="a6aafb">Meteoric Sword</font> damage counts as Basic Attack damage and can trigger Attack Effects. Hitting heroes restores 100 <font color="a6aafb">Malice Energy</font> (excess is preserved).

Argus removes all debuffs on himself, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fba51f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and becoming the <font color="a6aafb">Fallen Angel</font> for 4s (hitting heroes enhances <font color="a6aafb">Warmonger</font>). <font color="a6aafb">Fallen Angel</font>: Gains 40% Movement Speed that decays over 1s; when the transformation ends, he converts all his damage dealt in the Fallen Angel state into HP. If he takes fatal damage in the Fallen Angel state, the duration of the Movement Speed boost will be reset, and he will gain <font color="a6aafb">Death Immunity</font> for 4s. <font color="a6aafb">Enhanced Warmonger</font>: <font color="a6aafb">Demonic Slash</font> grants 50 Malice Energy (50 extra Malice Energy with critical hits).
If <font color="a6aafb">Death Immunity</font> isn't triggered, the cooldown will be reduced by 50%.

data.name: Argus
data.story: The angel who fell from light into darkness.

assist.desc: Argus works well with utility Supports like Angela and Rafaela who can provide extra Movement Speed and CC to allow Argus to stick to his targets and dish out maximum damage.

strong.desc: Argus counters heroes with poor mobility who cannot escape his attacks once he closes in, such as Gord and Aurora.

weak.desc: Argus is countered by Tanks with high Physical Defense, like Gatotkaca and Tigreal, because a lot of his damage comes from Basic Attacks.
