skilllist.skilldesc:
Grock gains a Shield equal to 14% of his Max HP and empowers the next Basic Attack to deal <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 4<font color="26e407"> (+2% Total Physical Defense)</font>% of the target's Max HP (capped at 300<font color="ffe63c">(+20*Hero Level)</font> against non-hero units). This effect has a 18-12s cooldown (decreases with level), which reduces by 200% when near terrain.

Grock's skills cannot be interrupted, and he gains 30<font color="ffe63c">(+6*Hero Level)</font>% extra Physical Defense while the Shield is active.

Grock strikes forward with massive force, dealing 240<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Enemies with obstacles behind them are knocked back into the obstacle, launched airborne, and take extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 4<font color="26e407"> (+2% Total Physical Defense)</font>% of their Max HP (capped at 300<font color="ffe63c">(+20*Hero Level)</font> against non-hero units). If there are no obstacles behind, enemies are only knocked back slightly.

After a brief delay, Grock summons a stone wall in the target area, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and knocking enemies towards him.
<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Cancel the wall early.

Grock charges forward and gains Control Immunity, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in his path. Upon hitting terrain, he immediately stops and triggers a massive explosion that knocks nearby enemies airborne for 1s and deals 650<font color="fba51f"> (+300% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. If this skill doesn't hit terrain, 50% of its cooldown is refunded.

data.name: Grock
data.story: Stone man awakened from sleep.

assist.desc: Grock's Ultimate is a powerful CC that covers a wide area,so he pairs well with Mages like Odette and Pharsa to maximize their AOE damage.

strong.desc: Grock works well against heroes who cannot Blink over his wallto escape his CC,such as Gord and Layla.

weak.desc: Grock is countered by Magic Damage heroes with Blink who can kite him with relative ease,such as Kimmy and Harley.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Irithel and Leo's immaculate teamwork allows her to shoot while moving. Each Basic Attack will shoot 2 crossbow bolt(s) (but takes longer to refill) that deal <font color="fba51f"> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> per bolt (inherits a portion of Attack Effects).
Moving will build up <font color="a6aafb">Jungle Heart</font>, up to a maximum of 10 units, and cause the next Basic Attack to unleash 1 additional bolt(s).

Irithel launches a volley of arrows on the target area, dealing 330<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within and reducing their Physical Defense by 15 for 3s.
Leo lets out a piercing roar, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 2s.

Irithel orders Leo to leap in the target direction and empowers her crossbow for 10s. For the duration, she gains 30 Movement Speed and her Basic Attacks shoot enhanced crossbow bolts, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+65% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and nearby units. <font color="a6aafb">Jungle Heart</font> also accumulates faster for the duration.

data.name: Irithel
data.story: The forest hunter with a smilodon.

assist.desc: Irithel works best with heroes that can slow or provide hard CC such as Valir and Hylos because they allow her more opportunities to deal damage.

strong.desc: Irithel counters heroes with a shorter Basic Attack range than her or ones that lack mobility and can be easily kited, such as Miya and Alpha.

weak.desc: Irithel is countered by heroes with strong CC capabilities or can restrict movement, such as Badang and Silvanna. Because Irithel does not have any Blink skills, her advantage vanishes once her mobility is restricted.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Harley's mastery of magic allows his Basic Attacks and skills to reduce the enemy's Magic Defense by 2 and increase his Attack Speed by 5%-10% (scales with hero level) for 3s on hit. This effect stacks up to 10 times.
Harley's Basic Attacks deal 60<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

Harley throws 3 waves of cards, 3 cards per wave. Each card deals 130<font color="62f8fe"> (+25% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies.
After the same target is hit 3 time(s), the damage will decay to 50% on subsequent hits.

Harley blinks in the designated direction, leaving a magic hat at his starting location. His Movement Speed increases by 60% for 2s, then rapidly decays to normal over 4s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Return to the hat's location.

Harley casts a magic ring of fire at an enemy hero, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and a 40% slow effect that decays to 15% after 1.5s. The ring will stay around the target, during which Harley can hit the ring to damage the target. The ring will explode after 4s, dealing <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 30% of the damage taken by the target while the ring was active.

data.name: Harley
data.story: The young mage whose powers awakened once thrust into danger and who now arrives at the Magic Academy to study.

assist.desc: Harley is best with heroes who can disrupt the enemy formation like Akai and Khufra. He can follow them into the fight and burst down the squishy targets.

strong.desc: Harley counters squishy heroes with poor mobility, such as Cecilion and Ixia, since he can deal burst damage while being on the move.

weak.desc: Harley is countered by tanky heroes like Lolita and Uranus, because Harley can't deal enough meaningful damage to them and they can block and tank his Ultimate for their teammates.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Gatotkaca gains Physical Defense equal to 2% of his lost HP (up to 200). For every 300 damage he takes (calculated before damage reduction), he gains 5 Rage (up to 100).

Upon reaching over 25 Rage, Gatotkaca's next Basic Attack becomes enhanced, consuming all Rage to deal extra <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and recover HP. The extra damage scales with his Rage, level, and Magic Power.

Gatotkaca slams the ground, creating a shattered zone in the target direction while dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within. Enemies in the shattered zone will take 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+20% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> per second and be slowed by 30%.

Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, taunting enemies on the path to attack him, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> for 0.9 - 1.5s. The taunt duration and sprint distance scale with the channel time. Canceling the skill reduces 50% of the remaining cooldown.

Gatotkaca jumps to the target location, dealing 500<font color="62f8fe"> (+300% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 1s. Enemies near the center of the area will be knocked airborne for a longer duration, while enemies on the fringes will be pulled to the center.

The camera will move with the skill indicator but won't grant extra sight.

data.name: Gatotkaca
data.story: Warrior from the Arcadhem universe.

assist.desc: Gatotkaca works best with heroes with strong CC and damage, such as Kagura and Vale who can give his Ultimate even more value.

strong.desc: Due to his great CC and high Physical Defense, Gatotkaca counters Marksmen with no mobility skills like Layla and Popol and Kupa..

weak.desc: Gatotkaca is countered by heroes that can remove CC like Diggie and Wanwan who will greatly reduce his effectiveness.

skilllist.skilldesc: Karrie's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Lightwheel Mark</font> on hit. Once a target has 5 stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Lightwheel Marks</font>, the marks will turn into a lightwheel, dealing <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> equal to 5<font color="fba51f"> (+1% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of the target's Max HP to them (only up to 300 damage against Creeps).

Karrie releases a sphere of surging energy in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path. The sphere will stop upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its max travel distance, continuously dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 80% for 1s.

Karrie dashes in the target direction while throwing a lightwheel at the nearest enemy, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and applying a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Lightwheel Mark</font> on them.

When in <font color="a6aafb">Dual Wield</font> state, Karrie throws two lightwheels instead.

Karrie enters <font color="a6aafb">Quadruple Wield</font> state for 10s, gaining 20% Movement Speed. Each Basic Attack deals 40<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and throws 2 lightwheels that inherit a portion of Attack Effects.

data.name: Karrie
data.story: Indifferent and powerful Yasson.

assist.desc:
Assassins like Saber and Aamon who can eliminate 
ranged threats so Karrie can focus the frontline.

strong.desc: Tanks such as Tigreal and Fredrinn that take more damage from her HP percent attacks.

weak.desc: Long range heroes such as Xavier, Layla and Nana due to Karrie's medium range.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms.

In human form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's current HP.

In wolf form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's lost HP.

This effect can only deal up to 60 additional damage against Creeps.

Roger fires two quick shots in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> in total to the enemy hit. The first shot is a hunter net that slows the enemy by 80% for 1.5s, while the second is a bullet that reduces the enemy's Physical Defense by 10 for 5s.
Roger gains 20% Movement Speed and 20% Attack Speed for 2.5s.

Roger lunges in the target direction and turns into wolf form, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 90% for 0.8s.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: In wolf form, Roger gains 20 Physical & Magic Defense and 25 Movement Speed.

Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms.

In human form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's current HP.

In wolf form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's lost HP.

This effect can only deal up to 60 additional damage against Creeps.

Roger lunges at the target enemy, becoming untargetable while dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to up to 3 enemies in the area.

Getting a kill or assist will reduce the cooldown of this skill by 80%.

Roger lets out a howl, increasing his Attack Speed by 1.15 times for 5s and revealing nearby enemy heroes with HP below 40%. If there are enemy heroes with HP below 40% in range, Roger gains 50% Movement Speed.
Roger rolls in the target direction and reverts back to human form, gaining a 200<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> shield for 1.5s.

data.name: Roger
data.story: A werewolf wandering in the dark forest longing for revenge.

assist.desc: Roger works best with heroes with high AOE damage that can nuke the enemy team to low HP for him to finish off, such as Pharsa and Vexana.

strong.desc: Roger counters squishy heroes that lack mobility such as Hanabi and Odette because they cannot easily escape from him.

weak.desc: Roger is countered by heroes that can restrict his mobility and prevent him from jumping in and out using his two forms, like Minsitthar and Khufra.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_743edd1702084c4ed247908d698bca77.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Vexana and her <font color="a6aafb">Eternal Guard</font> inflict <font color="a6aafb">Nether Touch</font> on enemies hit. The mark lasts 5s and causes the affected enemy to explode upon death, dealing 108-500<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies (base damage scales with level).

Vexana unleashes a <font color="a6aafb">Deathly Grasp</font> in the target direction, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in its path. It stops upon hitting an enemy hero, <font color="a6aafb">Terrifying</font> and knocking them back. After a short delay, it explodes, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and <font color="a6aafb">Terrifying</font> them for 1s.

Vexana marks the target area with the power of the undead, striking it after a 0.8s delay and dealing 580<font color="62f8fe"> (+165% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit.

Vexana summons an <font color="a6aafb">Eternal Guard</font> at the target location, dealing 480<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.8s. The <font color="a6aafb">Eternal Guard</font> then joins Vexana in battle for 15s. Its attacks deal 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 5% target's Max HP) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and Splash Damage in a large area.

data.name: Vexana
data.story: The young duchess guarding Necrokeep.

assist.desc:
Heroes with powerful CC such as Atlas or
high damage output like Beatrix to burst down enemies.

strong.desc: Backline DPS heroes such as Layla, Irithel and Xavier.

weak.desc: Mobile Assassins such as Saber, Aamon and Karina.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_28036c4584c914c5aad4d2feeafb2452.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Lapu-Lapu accumulates 10 <font color="a6aafb">Bravery Blessing</font> each time he deals damage (halved for damage dealt to non-hero units). When <font color="a6aafb">Bravery Blessing</font> is full, Lapu-Lapu's next <font color="a6aafb">Basic Attack</font> will make him dash toward the target, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (cannot Crit) and granting him a shield that absorbs 250 (+65*Hero Level) damage for 2.5s.

Lapu-Lapu releases two boomerangs in the target direction, each boomerang dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit on its way out and back.

Enemies hit by both boomerangs take 50% damage from the second hit.
Lapu-Lapu dashes in the target direction, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way.

Lapu-Lapu leaps to the target location while combining his twin blades into one, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies upon landing and slowing them by 60% for 1s. (This skill cannot be interrupted.)
Lapu-Lapu gains 3 times the <font color="a6aafb">Bravery Blessing</font> from this skill and skills in transformed state.
For the next 10s, Lapu-Lapu enters <font color="a6aafb">Great Sword</font> stance and gains enhanced skills, 30 extra Physical & Magic Defense, and his Basic Attack damage is increased to 120%.

Lapu-Lapu accumulates 10 <font color="a6aafb">Bravery Blessing</font> each time he deals damage (halved for damage dealt to non-hero units). When <font color="a6aafb">Bravery Blessing</font> is full, Lapu-Lapu's next <font color="a6aafb">Basic Attack</font> will make him dash toward the target, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (cannot Crit) and granting him a shield that absorbs 250 (+65*Hero Level) damage for 2.5s.

Lapu-Lapu channels for 0.7s, slowing enemies in the target direction by 60%. He then slams his heavy sword to the ground, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and stunning them for 1s. (This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.)

Lapu-Lapu whirls his heavy sword, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

When hitting an enemy hero, Lapu-Lapu gains 20% Damage Reduction, plus an additional 8% for each extra enemy hero hit, lasting 3s.

Lapu-Lapu swings his heavy sword 3 times. The first two attacks deal 345<font color="fba51f"> (+160% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each, while the third deals 440<font color="fba51f"> (+210% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a large area.

Lapu-Lapu gains Control Immunity during this process and can change his attack direction and move a short distance on each attack.

data.name: Lapu-Lapu
data.story: Hero who defends the Vonetis Islands from outsiders

assist.desc: Lapu-Lapu works well with heroes who can pull enemies together, like Tigreal and Atlas, to allow his AOE skills to hit more targets and get more Damage Reduction from his 2nd Skill in Great Sword stance by hitting more heroes.

strong.desc: Lapu-Lapu is strong against squishy heroes who lack movement abilities, such as Layla and Eudora, because he has high burst damage and can use his mobility to get on top of them.

weak.desc: Lapu-Lapu is countered by agile Marksmen who can knock him away, such as Lesley and Moskov. They can speed up or blink to avoid Lapu-Lapu's Ultimate, and use knockback effects to interrupt his 1st Skill in Great Sword stance or to keep him away.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_f9b2be0150361018bb98f941b9667c42.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Upon taking fatal damage, Aurora freezes herself for 1.5s, becoming invincible and gradually recovering 30% Max HP. Cooldown: 150s.

Aurora's freeze effects can also affect Turrets.

Aurora summons an icy meteorite to strike at the target location, dealing 400<font color="62f8fe"> (+90% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing targets hit by 40% for 1s. Afterward, 5 hailstones fall, each dealing 40<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

Aurora blows <font color="a6aafb">Frosty Breeze</font> in a fan-shaped area in the target direction, dealing 225<font color="62f8fe"> (+75% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and creating a frozen area at the far end.

The area deals a total of 225<font color="62f8fe"> (+75% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within and freezes them for 1s (increases by 0.06s for every 100 Magic Power).

Aurora creates a frost path in the target direction, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in the path and slowing them by 80% for 1.2s.

data.name: Aurora
data.story: The Maiden of the Glacier who grants eternal remembrance in the legends of the North.

assist.desc: With her very powerful CC abilities, Aurora works well with heroes who deal high sustained damage, like Ixia, Freya, and Karrie.

strong.desc: Aurora counters heroes who like to charge in, such as Leomord, Thamuz, and Terizla, since her skills can stop them dead in their tracks.

weak.desc: Because most of Aurora's skills have delayed effects, she is countered by high mobility heroes who can dodge them with ease, such as Ling, Kadita, and Guinevere.

data.name: Hilda
data.story: Inheritor of the Power of the Megalith.

assist.desc: Hilda works well with tanky heroes, which can create room for her to dish out more damage. Such as Atlas and Tigreal.

strong.desc: Hilda excels in prolonged battles. She works well against heroes with lower burst damage. Such as Zilong and Layla.

weak.desc: Hilda is countered by heroes with high sustain. Such as Thamuz and Uranus. This is because they can utilize their healing abilities to prevent being executed.

data.name: Estes
data.story: Elf King who rules the Moon Elves.

assist.desc: Estes works best with typical Marksman heroes, his healing will allow them to deal more damage. Heroes like Lesley and Hanabi are good examples here.

strong.desc: Estes counters heroes with no burst damage, he can easily heal through minor damages from heroes like Faramis and Alice.

weak.desc: Estes is countered by heroes with high burst damage. Heroes like Saber and Eudora can easily burst down Estes or the hero he protects in a few seconds.

data.name: Cyclops
data.story: A celestial traveler in the universe.

assist.desc: Cyclops is best with tanky heroes with strong CC skills, like Belerick and Minsitthar.

data.name: Johnson

strong.desc:
Johnson counters melee heroes with high burst like Alucard and Zilong

data.name: Moskov
data.story: A warrior of the desert that embraced the darkness to seek his revenge.

assist.desc: Moskov works well with heroes like Atlas and Gatotkaca who can CC groups of enemies so he can focus on maximizing the damage of his piercing AOE.

data.name: Yi Sun-shin
data.story: Leader of the City of the Dragon Fleet.

assist.desc: Yi Sun-shin works best with Fighters who can initiate, such as Alpha and Khaleed, so he can follow up and unleash his full damage after they have CC'd the enemy.

strong.desc: Yi Sun-shin counters heroes that lack CC like Uranus and Terizla who are at the mercy of his ability to jump in and out of melee range using his 2 weapons.

weak.desc: Yi Sun-shin is countered by heroes with CC skills, such as Franco and Kaja who can lock him down and stop him from freely swapping weapons.

data.name: Ruby

data.name: Alpha

data.name: Sun

skilllist.skilldesc:
If Natalia stays in a bush without taking damage for 1s, she will enter <font color="a6aafb">Camouflage</font> state and gain 15% Movement Speed. In this state, Natalia's next Basic Attack will teleport her behind her target and deal 200<font color="fba51f"> (+110% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> while silencing the target for 0.25s.

Dealing damage, taking damage or using skills will immediately end the <font color="a6aafb">Camouflage</font> state, but her next Basic Attack will remain enhanced for another 1s.

Natalia's base Crit Damage is reduced to 150%, but her damage to Creeps is increased to 150%.

Natalia dashes in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in her path.

After hitting an enemy, she can cast this skill again within 5s.
Natalia releases a <font color="a6aafb">Smoke Bomb</font> at her location, slowing enemies within by 25% while Natalia becomes immune to enemy Basic Attacks for 4s.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Natalia gains 15% Crit Chance.

<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Natalia immediately enters the <font color="a6aafb">Assassin Instinct</font> state. She can store up to 2 Ultimate charges, and each charge has a recharge time of 30s. Killing creeps reduces the remaining recharge time by 50% of the full recharge time.

data.name: Natalia
data.story: An assassin exiled by the Empire.

assist.desc: Natalia works best with heroes with high AOE damage such as Yi Sun-shin and Vexana. She can stay hidden while they poke the enemy, then pounce on targets that get low on HP.

strong.desc: Natalia counters squishy heroes who lack CC and burst like as Novaria and Irithel since they can't stop Natalia's burst damage.

weak.desc: Natalia is countered by heroes who can restrict her mobility like Minsitthar and Kaja since they can easily shutdown her main advantage.

skilllist.skilldesc: After Gord hits an enemy 4 times with skills within a short period of time, the next skill damage will deal an additional 140 (+8*Hero Level) <font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> and slow them by 20% for 1s (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).

Gord conjures a Mystic Orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 225<font color="62f8fe"> (+65% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their locations for 1s.

Gord creates an energy field in the target area, dealing 30<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.25s to enemies within (up to 16 times).

Gord unleashes an energy beam in the target direction, dealing 110<font color="62f8fe"> (+32% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit every 0.2s (up to 16 times).

The direction of the beam can be adjusted using the Joystick.

data.name: Gord
data.story: Dean of the Icarus School of the Magic Academy.

assist.desc: Gord works well with tanky heroes with reliable CCs, like Hylos and Belerick.

strong.desc: Gord is strong against melee heroes with poor Mobility, such as Barats and Fredrinn.

weak.desc: Gord is countered by heroes with gap closers, such as Fanny and Lancelot.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Freya gains 1 <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orb</font> with each Basic Attack (up to 6 <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orbs</font>). Consuming 1 <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orb</font> grants Freya 100% Attack Speed for her next Basic Attack (max 6 stacks).
<font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orbs</font> gradually recover when out of combat.

Freya leaps to the target area and strikes the ground with her shield, gaining 500<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> shield and dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within while knocking them airborne for 0.4s.

Freya charges forward and slashes, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing enemies by 30% for 0.5s. This skill has no base cooldown but consumes 2 <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orbs</font> per cast.
This skill deals 50% damage to Creeps.

Freya selects a target area and dives down as a Sacred Orb (gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction), dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and 40% slow to enemies in her path and at the landing point for 2s.

Upon landing, Freya enters the <font color="a6aafb">Valkyrie</font> state for 12s, during which her Basic Attacks deal 30 extra damage (extra damage cannot Crit) and she recovers 40<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP per Basic Attack, and her Basic Attacks deal splash damage.

data.name: Freya
data.story: The Valkyrie who guards the Northern Vale.

assist.desc: In order for Freya to maximize her damage, she prefers heroes with CC like Belerick and Gatotkaca to lock down the enemy for her.

strong.desc: Freya not only has exceptional mobility, she also excels in prolonged engagements, making her highly effective against fragile, low-HP Marksmen, such as Lesley and Ixia. Her excellent sustained damage and mobility also allows her to counter Tanks with low damage, like Uranus and Baxia.

weak.desc: However, all of Freya's skills have movement components, making her vulnerable to Phoveus's unique counter. Using her skills near Phoveus will allow him to quickly gain energy for his enhanced Basic Attacks. Freya is vulnerable to CC and movement-disabling effects, so Minsitthar and Obsidia's Ultimates can lock her down completely.

skilllist.skilldesc: Hayabusa's attacks apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Mark</font> on hit (up to 4 stacks). Each stack lasts 6s and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Hayabusa permanently gains 3% Spell Vamp.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Hayabusa throws three returning shurikens in the target direction, each dealing 220<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2s. Subsequent hits on the same enemy deal 70% less damage (only 50% less to creeps). He also restores 10 Energy when hitting non-minion enemies.

Hayabusa dashes in the target direction and releases four phantoms that travel in separate directions. The phantoms will remain at the end of their paths or attach themselves to the first enemy hero hit, dealing 130<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing them by 40% for 2s. Hayabusa will immediately stop if he hits an enemy hero during the dash.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Hayabusa teleports to a phantom's location and reduces the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken</font> by 1s. If the phantom is attached to an enemy hero, he also deals 130<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the enemy.

Hayabusa blends into the shadows and launches 6 single-target attacks on enemies in the area, each dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+32% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

The attacks prioritize enemies with <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Mark</font> and each will consume a mark to deal 90<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Extra Physical Attack)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Shadow Kill does not apply <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Mark</font>.

data.name: Hayabusa
data.story: The young leader of the Shadow Sect who wields his blade through moonless nights, walking the path of nindo without fear.

assist.desc: Hayabusa works best with Fighters like Lapu-Lapu and Alpha who can initiate with him to quickly focus down key targets.

strong.desc: Hayabusa counters squishy heroes that lack CC to shutdown the blinks from his 2nd Skill, and who are also easy targets for his Ultimate, such as Chang'e and Cecilion.

weak.desc: Hayabusa is countered by heroes with targeted CC like Franco and Kaja who can lock him down before he can blink away.

skilllist.skilldesc: Every 3s to 6s (scales with <font color="a6aafb">Noumenon Blast</font> level), the Noumenon Energy Core grants Lolita 20<font color="26e407"> (+2.5% Total HP)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+20% Total Magic Power)</font> shield. When Lolita casts a skill, the Noumenon Energy Core grants Lolita and nearby allied heroes an extra shield. This shield can stack up to 3 times and lasts 30s.

Lolita dashes in the target direction. Her next Basic Attack within 4s will perform a short dash to the target, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and stunning them for 0.5s. This damage is doubled against Minions.

Lolita raises her shield and reflects all incoming ranged Basic Attacks and <font color="a6aafb">Projectiles</font> in the direction of the shield for 3s. The shield will break after taking 1000<font color="26e407"> (+15% Total HP)</font> damage.

The damage and effects from the Unique Passives of an attacker's equipment will not apply to the shield and will not be reflected. This skill can be interrupted by high level control effects.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Reduces the interval of <font color="a6aafb">Noumenon Energy Core</font> by 1s each time this skill is upgraded.

<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Lolita begins charging for 2s while slowing enemies in a fan-shaped area by 60%. When the charging is complete or is stopped, Lolita slams her hammer on the ground, dealing up to 600<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and stunning them for up to 2s (damage and stun duration scale with charge time).

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Lolita immediately stops charging and slams her hammer on the ground.

data.name: Lolita
data.story: Member of the Eruditio Rangers and protector of the Leviathan workshop.

assist.desc: Due to her powerful defensive and CC abilities, Lolita is great at protecting Marksmen like Hanabi and Layla.

strong.desc: Lolita's shield makes her strong against heroes who rely on projectiles and ranged skills, such as Kimmy and Cyclops.

weak.desc: Lolita is countered by melee heroes with high burst damage like Ling and Paquito.

skilllist.skilldesc:
After casting a skill, Minotaur gains <font color="a6aafb">Motivation</font>, recovering HP equal to 5 (+1*Hero Level)% of damage taken from enemy heroes for 3s.

<font color="a6aafb">Enraged State</font>: <font color="a6aafb">Motivation</font> HP recovery is increased to 200%.

Minotaur jumps to the target location, dealing 280<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and briefly knocking them airborne. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 40% while Minotaur enhances his Basic Attacks to deal <font color="26e407"> (+3% Total HP)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> for 2s.

<font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font>: Increases the AOE range and the damage dealt by <font color="26e407"> (+3% Total HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

Minotaur heals himself and the nearby ally with the lowest HP, recovering 220<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> HP for both of them and healing himself for an additional 8% of his lost HP.

<font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font>: Minotaur heals himself and all nearby allied heroes.

Minotaur enters <font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font> state and smashes the ground 3 times. The first 2 hits deal 180<font color="fba51f"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slow them by 60%, while the final hit deals 200<font color="ffe63c"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> and knocks targets airborne for 0.8s. Minotaur is immune to control effects during this attack.

The <font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font> state lasts 12s and enhances Minotaur's skills for the duration.

data.name: Minotaur
data.story: Minoan prince determined to restore his homeland.

assist.desc: Minotaur works best with burst damage Marksmen, such as Granger and Melissa, since his CC's give them more opportunities to deal damage.

strong.desc: Minotaur is strong against heroes that rely on chaining skills or attacks, like Paquito and Julian because he can interrupt their combos with his CC.

weak.desc: Minotaur is countered by long-range Marksmen like Layla and Lesley since his lack of speed makes him an easy target.

skilllist.skilldesc: Layla deals increased damage to enemies farther away from her (starting at 100% and increasing to 115% at 6 units away). This does not include Turrets.

Layla fires a Malefic Bomb in the target direction, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit (can Crit).

Upon hitting an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and <font color="a6aafb">Void Projectile</font> gain extra range for 3s, and she gains 60% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s. The duration of the Movement Speed boost is doubled if an enemy hero is hit.

Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy at the target enemy that explodes on hit, dealing 170<font color="fba51f"> (+65% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to targets in the area and applying a <font color="a6aafb">Magic Mark</font> on them for 3s.
When Layla hits an enemy with a <font color="a6aafb">Magic Mark</font>, she deals 100<font color="fba51f"> (+35% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.25s.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: The range of <font color="a6aafb">Void Projectile</font> and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6 units. Layla's sight range is slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded. 
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing 500<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a line.

data.name: Layla
data.story: The backbone of the Eruditio Rangers who is also known as the Shining Star.

assist.desc: Layla works best with Tanks that can protect backline heroes, such as Minsitthar and Belerick, since their protection gives Layla more opportunities to deal damage.

strong.desc: Layla's relatively longer attack range lets her counter slow Tanks like Tigreal and Belerick.

weak.desc: Layla is countered by Assassins with high burst damage, such as Karina and Ling, as they can get the jump on Layla and melt her easily.

skilllist.skilldesc: During flight, Fanny deals 10%-20% extra damage to enemies hit (scales with flying speed) and applies a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Prey Mark</font> to them (up to 2 stacks) on each attack. Her subsequent skill hits on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack for her. The energy restoration is reduced if she hits multiple enemy heroes within a short period of time.
Fanny whirls her blades, dealing 275<font color="fba51f"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

Fanny shoots a cable in the target direction that pulls her to the first obstacle hit. She can cast this skill again within 2s until her energy runs out. Each successive cast reduces the skill's energy cost by 2.

Fanny automatically casts <font color="a6aafb">Tornado Strike</font> upon hitting an enemy mid-flight, as long as her energy is sufficient.

Fanny leaps at the target enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Each stack of <font color="a6aafb">Prey Mark</font> on the target increases this damage by 30%.

data.name: Fanny
data.story: A blade dancer in the battlefield.

assist.desc: Fanny works best with heroes that can chain AOE CC to keep the enemy pinned, such as Minotaur and Gatotkaca, so she can deal damage without interruption.

strong.desc: Fanny counters squishy heroes that lack targeted CC like Karrie and Irithel who cannot stop Fanny's extreme mobility while she bursts them down.

weak.desc: Fanny is countered by heroes that can restrict mobility, such as Kaja and Khufra, since they can easily shutdown her main advantage.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_9db57da4f0daef6d432676e4f19101ed.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
After dealing damage 3 time(s) with Basic Attacks or skills, Zilong triggers <font color="a6aafb">Dragon Flurry</font> on the next Basic Attack, hitting the target 3 time(s). Each hit deals 80<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> Basic Attack Damage and heals himself for 50<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP.

Zilong's Basic Attack deals 100<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

If the target's HP is below 50%, all damage dealt by Zilong's skills and Basic Attacks is increased by 30.
Zilong flings the target enemy over his head, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

Zilong lunges at the target enemy, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and reducing their Physical Defense by 15 for 2s.

The cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Spear Strike</font> is reset each time Zilong kills an enemy.

Zilong removes all slow effects on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, and Slow Immunity for 7.5s.

During this time, <font color="a6aafb">Dragon Flurry</font> triggers every 2 attacks (instead of the previous 3).

data.name: Zilong
data.story: Guardian of the Dragon Altar and the Oriental Fighter who inherited the Cloud Dragon's power.

assist.desc: Zilong works best with heroes with strong defensive abilities that can hold off enemy attacks while he solos the lane, such as Pharsa and Hanabi.

strong.desc: The immunity to Slow effects that Zilong gets from his Ultimate makes him strong against squishy heroes without CC skills, such as Layla and Lylia.

weak.desc: Zilong is still vulnerable to non-slow CC skills, making him weak against heroes with powerful single-target CC skills, such as Franco and Nana.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_68277dce415742c4a98883151c693a07.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Rafaela can cast a special skill every 40s. After channeling for 2.5s, she instantly resurrects an ally and increases their Movement Speed by 30% for 5s (taking damage from heroes and Legend Creeps interrupts channeling and puts the skill on base cooldown).
This skill's cooldown is increased by 500% of the target's remaining respawn time, capped at 240s. This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

Rafaela strikes the three nearest enemies with <font color="a6aafb">Light of Retribution</font>, dealing them 225<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, briefly revealing their positions, and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. Enemies hit by <font color="a6aafb">Light of Retribution</font> again within 6s will take 20% extra damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

Rafaela calls upon <font color="a6aafb">Holy Light</font>, recovering 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+35% Total Magic Power)</font> HP for nearby allied heroes, plus an additional 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+65% Total Magic Power)</font> HP for herself and the most injured allied hero in range. She also increases the Movement Speed of nearby allied heroes by 30% and grants Slow Immunity for 1s.

Every 10 point(s) of Magic Power will add 1% to the Movement Speed bonus.

Rafaela unleashes the true power of <font color="a6aafb">Holy Light</font> in the target direction, dealing 460<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in a line and stunning them for 1.2s.

data.name: Rafaela
data.story: An angel loved and respected by the people of this world.

assist.desc: When teamed up with Fighters like Freya and Lapu-Lapu, Rafaela can boost their offensive power and survivability.

strong.desc: Rafaela has great healing and decent mobility, and performs well against heroes that lack burst damage or mobility, such as Masha and Barats.

weak.desc: Rafaela struggles against bursty and agile Assassins, like Ling and Hayabusa.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_5a8345c69a4c9c611fdfce91089fe74a.png

skilllist.skilldesc: After each skill cast, Clint's next Basic Attack within 4s penetrates a line of enemies, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. This damage can trigger attack effects, and the part affected by Physical Attack can Crit.

Clint fires 5 bullets in quick succession in the target direction, each dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the enemy hit.

The bullets will spread evenly across enemies in a fan-shaped area. Enemies hit by multiple bullets will take less damage after the first bullet.

Clint shoots a trap net in the target direction, slightly jumping back while dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

Successfully hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown of this skill by 40%.

Clint launches a grenade in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 280<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing them by 50% for 0.5s.

Clint gains a grenade charge every 10s (up to 3).

data.name: Clint
data.story: A sharpshooter full of righteousness and justice.

assist.desc: Clint works best with Supportsthat can enhance his kiting ability, such as Rafaela and Angela.

strong.desc: Clint counters heroes with comparatively shorter range like Moskov and Miya thanks to the superior range of his skills and Basic Attacks.

weak.desc: Clint is countered by Marksmen with burst damage like Melissa and Karrie since he lacks burst in the early and mid game to trade blows with them.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_ff39deb9c6afec3d977fdbe9d86f78cb.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Bruno gains 2.5% extra Crit Chance each time he deals damage with his skills (up to 8 stacks).

Bruno has higher Physical Attack but only gains 80% extra Attack Speed from all sources.

Bruno kicks a Powerball on his next Basic Attack, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target, slowing them by 30%, and speeding up by 30% for 0.5s.

The Powerball then bounces back toward Bruno and lands on the ground. He or allied heroes can retrieve the Powerball for another attack and reduce the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Flying Tackle</font> by 1s.

Bruno makes a slide tackle in the target direction, dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in his path and stunning them for 0.5s.

If the Powerball is bouncing back, Bruno also draws the Powerball toward him.

Bruno kicks his Energy Ball at the target enemy hero, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+83% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and knocking them back. The Energy Ball then bounces between nearby enemies up to 10 times, each time dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Each hit also reduces the enemy's Physical Defense by 4% for 8s (up to 3 stacks).

data.name: Bruno
data.story: The captain of the Eruditio Rangers that protects the city with his amazing football skills.

assist.desc: Bruno is best with Supports that can force enemies to engage and allow him to make use of his early game damage, such as Franco and Khufra.

strong.desc: Bruno is strong against Marksmen that are weaker in the early game like Hanabi and Miya who Bruno can out-trade thanks to his high damage.

weak.desc: Bruno is countered by Tanks with high Physical Defense like Gatotkaca and Fredrinn that take greatly reduced damage from his attacks.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_7e4e74bb161da0f477cc0d1819fa39e6.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Bane infuses his weapon with a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Tidal Energy</font> each time he uses a skill (up to 2 stacks). Each of his subsequent Basic Attacks consumes a stack to deal <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to <font color="fba51f"> (+95% Total Physical Attack)</font> plus 4(+0.4*Hero Level)% of the target's Max HP to nearby enemies.

Bane fires his Crab Claw Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+160% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and then 150% damage to a random enemy behind them (prioritizes enemy heroes). Enemies hit are slowed by 10<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font>% for 1s.

Every 100 <font color="fba51f">Physical Attack</font> Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 8%.

Bane swallows a cup of sea ink, recovering 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 5<font color="62f8fe"> (+1.5% Total Magic Power)</font>% his lost HP), gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Bane spits corrosive ink in a fan-shaped area, dealing 140<font color="62f8fe"> (+130% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (up to 200% with charging time).

Every 100 <font color="62f8fe">Magic Power</font> Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by 7%.

Bane summons a school of sharks to charge in the target direction, dealing 700<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit, knocking them airborne for 0.6s, and slowing them by 75% (decays over 3s).
This skill deals 40% damage to turrets.

data.name: Bane
data.story: Cruel pirate leader, Franco's sworn enemy.

assist.desc: Bane works best with heroes like as Tigreal and Luo Yi who can pull enemies together so he can do even more damage with his AOE.

strong.desc: Bane counters Tanks with high HP but low damage, such as Hylos and Belerick, because he can out-sustain them and deals HP percentage-based damage.

weak.desc: Bane is countered by Mages that deal heavy damage from afar, such as Vale and Xavier who can deal significant damage to him before he can get in range.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage_2_1_60_2/100_9bed3c0095335606e0ce616c6e5a8553.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
If no damage is taken within 5s, Franco gains 10% Movement Speed, recovers 1% Max HP per second, and begins accumulating <font color="a6aafb">Wasteland Force</font> (up to 10 stacks).

Franco will consume all <font color="a6aafb">Wasteland Force</font> stacks on his next skill cast to increase the skill's damage by up to 150%.

Franco launches an iron hook in the target direction. The hook will snag the first enemy unit hit, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and dragging them to Franco.
Franco lashes out, dealing <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 300 plus 4% of his Max HP to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1.5s.

Franco suppresses the target enemy hero for 1.8s and strikes them 6 times over the duration, each time dealing 50<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

data.name: Franco
data.story: Brave permafrost warrior, Bane's sworn enemy.

assist.desc: Heroes with high burst damage such as Vale, Karina and Brody to take advantage of his CC.

strong.desc: Heroes with low mobility like Vale, Estes and Layla.

weak.desc: Heroes with high mobility or Control Immunity such as Wanwan, Fanny and Badang.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_28f223447f0174336ff0922d364d81d3.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Akai gains a 25<font color="26e407"> (+5% Total HP)</font> shield for 4s on each skill cast and marks enemy heroes and Creeps hit by his skills.

Akai's Basic Attacks deal 25<font color="26e407"> (+5% Total HP)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to marked enemies.

Akai charges in the target direction, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way. If Akai hits an enemy hero during this process, he'll knock them airborne for 0.5s and be able to roll in the Joystick's direction once.

Akai can cast <font color="a6aafb">Headbutt</font> during <font color="a6aafb">Heavy Spin</font> to quickly adjust his position.
Akai smashes the ground with his body, dealing 270<font color="26e407"> (+6% Total HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 45% for 2s.

Akai removes all debuffs on him and spins for 4s, gaining Slow Immunity while continuously dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Enemy heroes knocked back will knock back other heroes they collide with during the process.

Akai also gradually increases his Movement Speed by 70% over the duration. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.

data.name: Akai
data.story: The almighty panda hero of Stream Valley.

assist.desc: Akai works best with heroes who can deal high burst damage as they can help him take down enemies caught in his Ultimate, such as Saber and Eudora.

strong.desc: Akai is strong against heroes with poor Mobility since he can easily catch and eliminate them with his Ultimate, such as Eudora and Odette.

weak.desc: Akai is countered by heroes with CC removers or transformation abilities that allow them to escape or counter Akai's Ultimate, such as Nana and Diggie.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_f49394186dc0e55d545da8377be83280.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Karina's third consecutive attack on the same enemy deals extra <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> equal to 100 plus 5<font color="62f8fe"> (+2.5% Total Magic Power)</font>% of their lost HP (up to 2000 <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> against creeps).

If the target is an enemy hero, the cooldowns of Karina's non-Ultimate skills are reduced by 1.5s.

Karina enters the <font color="a6aafb">Dance of Blades</font> state for 3.5s, during which she gains 45% extra Movement Speed, blocks all incoming Basic Attacks, and reflects 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> back to the attacker (the damage reflection effect has a cooldown of 0.4s).

Karina's next Basic Attack within the duration deals 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+55% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, slows the target by 45% for 1s, and is guaranteed to Crit. Casting the enhanced Basic Attack or <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Assault</font> ends the <font color="a6aafb">Dance of Blades</font> state early.
Karina launches a spinning slash, dealing 375<font color="62f8fe"> (+125% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

Karina dashes to the target enemy hero, dealing them 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+160% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, applying a <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Mark</font> to them, and leaving a <font color="a6aafb">Shadowform</font> behind them. The <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Mark</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Shadowform</font> both last 5s. If the enemy dies within the duration, the cooldown of this skill is reset.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Karina dashes back to the <font color="a6aafb">Shadowform</font>'s location, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies along the way.

data.name: Karina
data.story: Killer from the Dark Elf tribe who is fighting to rescue her sister Selena.

assist.desc: Karina works well with heroes who can pull enemies together, such as Tigreal and Faramis, since her Ultimate and 2nd Skill also hits anyone near her main target, setting them up to be chain killed by her Ultimate.

strong.desc: Karina counters Marksmen that lack mobility, such as Layla and Hanabi, since her 1st Skill can neutralize their Basic Attacks and they can't escape her high mobility and burst damage.

weak.desc: Karina is countered by Tanky heroes with CC abilities, like Akai and Khufra because they can tank her damage, and protect their allies from her.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_0f51b6906e08897aa02330d65b0deeac.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
After each skill cast, Alucard's next Basic Attack allows him to dash to the target's location and deal <font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> Physical Damage.
<font color="a6aafb">Demon Hunter</font>: Alucard deals 10% extra damage to Creeps.

Alucard rolls to the target location and slams his blade on the ground, dealing 270<font color="fba51f"> (+85% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 2s.
Alucard launches a whirling slash, dealing 345<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Alucard permanently gains 10% Hybrid Lifesteal.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Alucard absorbs the energy of enemies in the target area, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% and Hybrid Defense by 10. Alucard gains 10 Hybrid Defense for each enemy hero hit, and reduces the cooldown of his other skills to 50% for 6s.
<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Alucard releases a shockwave in the target direction, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit.

data.name: Alucard
data.story: Demon hunter who detests the darkness.

assist.desc: He's best with heroes with crowd control, such as Gatotkaca and Xavier, which makes up for his lack of powerful control abilities.

strong.desc: Alucard has great chase abilities and damage resistance, making him powerful against squishy Assassins like Harley and Aamon.

weak.desc:
But he can be countered by heroes with powerful control abilities like Franco and Johnson. If controlled, Alucard won't be able to steal HP
and can be easily eliminated.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_8b30576754be1a4f8bebd09df8d6bec7.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Tigreal gains a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Fearless</font> each time he uses a skill or is hit by a Basic Attack. After getting 4 stacks, Tigreal will consume all <font color="a6aafb">Fearless</font> stacks to block the next incoming Basic Attack (including attacks from Turrets).

<font color="A4AAC7">Attacks from Minions do not grant</font> <font color="a6aafb">Fearless</font> <font color="A4AAC7">stacks nor trigger its effect</font>.

Tigreal smashes the ground with his hammer and sends a shockwave that erupts 3 times in the target direction, each time dealing 270<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the fan-shaped area and slowing them by 20%/40%/60% for 1.5s.

Tigreal charges in the target direction, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way and pushing them to the end of the charge.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Tigreal can use this skill again within 4s, dealing 280<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in front of him and knocking them airborne for 0.6s.

Tigreal unleashes the power of his hammer, pulling nearby enemies to him and stunning them for 1.8s while dealing 600<font color="fba51f"> (+130% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

<font color="A4AAC7">The first half of the channeling can be interrupted by control effects. The second half of the channeling can only be interrupted by Suppression.</font>

data.name: Tigreal
data.story: Leader of the Light's Order, guardian of the Moniyan Empire.

assist.desc: Tigreal works well with heroes with strong initiation skills, that gives him a better chance to hit the enemies with his CC skills, such as Vexana and Odette.

strong.desc: Tigreal's Passive can negate enemy Basic Attacks, making him strong against heroes that deal damage with their Basic Attacks, such as Zilong and Freya.

weak.desc: But as a melee hero, Tigreal is countered by Ranged Mage heroes like Chang'e and Zhask.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_ee1e0d80d87bb614a0c552ef028f85ce.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Upon taking fatal damage, Nana removes all debuffs on her and transforms, becoming untargetable and invincible, and gains 30% Movement Speed for 2s. She also recovers 10% Max HP over the duration.

Nana can only transform once every 150s and cannot cast skills in the transformed form.

Nana hurls her Magic Boomerang in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies hit on its way out and back. The boomerang deals 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the first enemy hit. For every additional enemy hit, the damage is reduced by 10% (max reduction of 30%).

Nana throws Molina at the target location, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within range and <font color="a6aafb">Transforming</font> enemy heroes hit into small animals.

If Molina does not hit an enemy hero, she will remain on the ground and chase the nearest enemy hero that comes into range, <font color="a6aafb">Transforming</font> the first enemy hero she touches.

<font color="a6aafb">Transform</font>: Reduces the target's Movement Speed by 50% and Magic Defense by 30% for 1.5s. Transformed heroes cannot attack or use skills.

Nana summons Molina to strike the target area 3 times, each time dealing 440<font color="62f8fe"> (+140% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within and slowing them by 30% for 1s. Enemies hit consecutively will be stunned for 1s.

data.name: Nana
data.story: Little Leonin with no worries.

assist.desc: Nana works best with heroes with CC skills, that will help her get the kills, such as Rafaela and Franco.

strong.desc: Nana's Passive gives her great survivability, making her strong against heroes with deadly combos, like Eudora and Kadita.

weak.desc: Nana can be countered by heroes with strong chasing abilities, like Zilong, Natalia, because they can chase Nana through her Passive duration.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage_2_1_18/100_18300163a5a912a84adb52b8d59b4618.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
When Alice's skills hit, she gains 1 stack(s) of <font color="a6aafb">Crimson</font>, lasting 4s. Once <font color="a6aafb">Crimson</font> reaches 2 stacks, <font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font> activates, dealing 25<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 0.5%-2.5% of the target's Max HP (scales with level) as <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby units (hitting heroes with skills refreshes the duration) and recovering 10<font color="26e407"> (+3% Extra Max HP)</font> HP for Alice every 0.5s.
While <font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font> is active, Alice gains 8% Movement Speed. <font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font> can deal up to 70(+10*Hero Level) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to creeps.

Alice fires blood energy forward, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. Before the blood energy dissipates, this skill can be cast again to activate <font color="a6aafb">Scarlet Shadow</font>, allowing Alice to blink to the blood energy's location.

Alice performs a deadly dance, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+130% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1s. If <font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font> is active at this time, it also scorches enemies, dealing 300% of <font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font>'s damage and healing Alice for the same amount.

Alice surrounds herself with blood, gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction while slowing herself by 50%. After 1.5s, she descends with force, dealing 500<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font><font color="26e407"> (+20% Extra Max HP)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies in range and immobilizing them for 1s.
While charging her Ultimate, Alice can only use <font color="a6aafb">Scarlet Shadow</font>.

data.name: Alice
data.story: Queen of the Blood Demons and one of the two dominant powers in the Abyss.

assist.desc: To compensate for Alice's weaknesses in the early game and form a balanced team, pair her with strong early game heroes, like Balmond or Dyrroth.

strong.desc: With her great sustainability in combat plus her mobility and CC, Alice counters heroes that lack burst and can't escape from melee enemies, such as Cecilion and Chang'e.

weak.desc: Alice is countered by heroes with Execute or Healing Reduction who can impede her from healing herself during the Ultimate. Heroes like Baxia or Martis can reduce her healing or kill her before she can heal.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_da894b37bfb5cadb32307f371f31918a.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Each time Miya hits a target with her Basic Attack, she gains 5% Attack Speed for 4s. Stacks up to 5 times.

After reaching full stacks, Miya summons a <font color="a6aafb">Moonlight Shadow</font> with each Basic Attack that deals 30<font color="fba51f"> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and inherits a portion of Attack Effects.

Miya shoots two extra arrows with each Basic Attack, dealing 10<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target enemy and 30% damage to nearby targets. This effect lasts 4s. Each extra arrow inherits a portion of Attack Effects.

Miya launches an empowered arrow on the target area, dealing 270<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2s. The arrow then splits into 6 scattering minor arrows, each dealing 40<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

Miya removes all debuffs on her and conceals herself, gaining 65% extra Movement Speed. This state lasts 2s or until she launches an attack.

Miya gains full stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Moon Blessing</font> upon leaving the state.

data.name: Miya
data.story: The Priestess of the Moon and protector of the Moonlit Forest.

assist.desc: Miya works well with Tanks who have powerful CC abilities like Belerick and Tigreal since their CCs give her more opportunities to dish out damage.

strong.desc: Miya counters heroes who rely on targeted CC effects, such as Saber and Eudora, because she can easily escape their CC and respond with a strong counterattack. The split arrows from her 1st Skill are also very effective against heroes that summon units, such as Sun.

weak.desc: Miya is countered by heroes with a lot of AOE damage, such as Pharsa and Yve, because they can still hit her while she is concealed.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage_2_1_18_2/100_df9a6990b1946d045e4d3a46c90725cf.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Balmond recovers 5% Max HP after killing a Minion or Creep, and 20% Max HP after killing a hero.

Balmond charges in the target direction for a set distance or until he hits an enemy hero, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way. The enemy hero hit will be knocked back slightly, and will have their Movement Speed reduced by 40% and Physical Defense reduced by 40% for 3s.

Balmond gains 15% Movement Speed that decays over time and spins with his axe for 3s, dealing 25<font color="26e407"> (+2% Extra Max HP)</font> <font color="fba51f"> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> per hit to nearby enemies up to 14 times. Each subsequent hit on the same enemy will deal 8.5% increased damage (up to 68%).

The Physical Attack bonus portion of the damage can Crit.

Balmond unleashes a huge strike in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> equal to 150<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> plus 30% of the target's lost HP.

This skill only deals up to 1000 damage to non-hero units.

data.name: Balmond
data.story: One day, the Orcs will break free from their shackles.

assist.desc: Balmond is best with Support heroes that can boost his Mobility and Survivability. Examples include Angela and Rafaela.

strong.desc: Balmond is strong against squishy heroes who lack the ability to escape once he closes the gap on them, such as Layla and Eudora.

weak.desc: Balmond is countered by ranged heroes who can deal damage to Balmond outside of his attack range, such as Lesley and Irithel.

data.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_6bbfac806f29d29f17fea9e98d2d2fee.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Each time Saber deals damage, he reduces the target's Physical Defense by 3-8 for 5s (up to 5 stacks).

Saber releases 5 swords that orbit around him and deal 80<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies on hit. The swords will retract back to him after the duration.

While active, Sword attacks deal 210<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and 50% damage to enemies along the path (damage reduced to 50% against minions). Each sword attack also reduces the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Charge</font> by 1s.

Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing 75<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the path.

After the dash, his next Basic Attack is enhanced, allowing him to dash to the target, dealing 75<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing them by 60% for 1s.

Saber charges at the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne for 1.2s (unaffected by Resilience). He strikes them 3 times over the duration, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> with the first 2 strikes and 240<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> with the third.

data.name: Saber
data.story: A swordsman in pursuit of invincibility, used by Laboratory 1718.

assist.desc: Saber works well with high-damage heroes who can help him burst down enemy heroes in teamfights, such as Kadita and Cyclops.

strong.desc: Saber's deadly combo makes him strong against squishy heroes, such as Layla and Eudora.

weak.desc: Saber is countered by Support heroes with Survivability buffs, like Estes and Faramis.
